title: RegimeVGGT: Layer-Wise Spatially Preserving Redundancy Removal for Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Jinhao You, Shuo Lyu, Zhuohang Lyu, Tanxuan Li, and Zibo Zhao contributed equally. Shuo Lyu is the corresponding author
summary: Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT) recovers dense 3D scene structure from multi-view images in one forward pass, but quadratic cross-frame attention limits its scalability. Existing training-free accelerators reduce computation uniformly along one axis, missing layer heterogeneity. Our spectral, probing, and causal analyses reveal three regimes: shallow layers lack cross-view structure, middle layers drive cross-view alignment, and deep layers are redundant for dense geometry yet their cross-frame attention remains essential for pose. RegimeVGGT applies layer-wise U-shaped compression along two axes: Saliency-Guided Banded Merging protects geometry- and edge-salient tokens, while Selectively Protected K/V Downsampling preserves cross-frame spatial coverage and the pose-critical path through a phase-shifted spatial grid, a reference-frame anchor, and uncompressed camera/register tokens. Training-free, RegimeVGGT achieves a 6.7x speedup over VGGT* at matched reconstruction quality.

AI.tldr: RegimeVGGT 通过层感知的 U 形双轴压缩策略，在无需训练的情况下实现了 6.7 倍加速，同时保持与 VGGT* 相当的密集 3D 重建质量。
AI.motivation: VGGT 的二次交叉帧注意力限制了其可扩展性，而现有加速方法均匀压缩忽略了层异质性。
AI.method: 通过谱分析、探针分析和因果分析揭示三层机制，提出层感知 U 形双轴压缩：显著性引导带状合并保护几何/边缘显著令牌，选择性保护 K/V 下采样通过相移空间网格、参考帧锚点和未压缩的相机/注册令牌保持空间覆盖和姿态关键路径。
AI.result: 在无需训练的条件下，RegimeVGGT 在匹配重建质量的同时实现了 6.7 倍加速。
AI.conclusion: RegimeVGGT 通过利用层异质性实现高效加速，为 VGGT 的可扩展性提供了有效解决方案。

title: Reasoning as Intersection: Consensus-Frame Alignment for Visual Focus in Video-MLLMs
summary: Reinforcement learning has improved the reasoning ability of large language models, but applying outcome-only rewards to video multimodal large language models (Video-MLLMs) provides limited guidance on which visual evidence should support the answer. Inspired by multisensory integration, where consistent cues can enhance the salience and reliability of perceptual estimates, we introduce Consensus Frame GRPO (CF-GRPO), a temporal-annotation-free process-level reward framework for evidence-aware video reasoning. CF-GRPO constructs a consensus frame prior from intrinsic video cues, including temporal coverage, scene-transition cues, and query-conditioned visual relevance. It then computes a model-side frame-use score from visual and response representations and optimizes their agreement through the Consensus Frame Reward (CFR). With salience-aware sparse aggregation and distribution sharpening, CFR provides a high-contrast reward signal without requiring human temporal annotations. Experiments show that VideoCFR achieves competitive performance across complex video reasoning benchmarks and improves several metrics over representative Video-MLLM and RL baselines, while the consensus prior provides an interpretable view of the evidence frames emphasized during training. The implementation is available at https://github.com/1Pansy/VideoCFR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CF-GRPO框架，通过构建共识帧先验和过程级奖励信号，无需时间标注即可增强视频多模态大模型的推理能力，实验证明其在复杂视频推理任务上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有结果奖励机制对视频多模态大模型提供的指导有限，无法明确告知模型哪些视觉证据应支撑答案，缺乏过程级的、可解释的奖励信号。
AI.method: 提出CF-GRPO框架：1) 从视频内时序覆盖、场景变换线索、查询条件视觉相关性构建共识帧先验；2) 计算模型侧帧使用分数；3) 通过共识帧奖励(CFR)优化两者一致性，采用显著性感知稀疏聚合和分布锐化生成高对比度奖励信号，无需人工时间标注。
AI.result: 在多个复杂视频推理基准上达到竞争性表现，在多项指标上优于代表性Video-MLLM和强化学习基线方法，且共识先验提供了训练中强调的证据帧的可解释视图。
AI.conclusion: CF-GRPO通过无标注的过程级奖励有效提升了视频推理能力，同时提供了可解释性，开源实现有助于后续研究。

title: NAVI-Orbital: First In-Orbit Demonstration of a Zero-Shot Vision-Language Model for Autonomous Earth Observation
summary: As Earth Observation data generation outpaces downlink bandwidth and human-in-the-loop processing, a widening gap has emerged between onboard collection and actionable ground intelligence. This paper presents NAVI-Orbital, a software system deployed on a Low Earth Orbit (LEO) spacecraft. On April 16, 2026, NAVI-Orbital achieved what is, to the authors' knowledge, the first in-orbit demonstration of a vision-language model performing autonomous multi-modal inference entirely onboard. NAVI-Orbital uses a local vision-language model (Gemma 3) to classify each captured scene, produce a text description of its content and the relationships between its features, and respond to operator follow-up via natural-language dialogue. The system is re-tasked through plain-English prompts in place of conventional command sequences, and is orchestrated by a graph-based state machine (LangGraph) coordinating dedicated agents for detection and dialogue. Results across ground benchmarking (88.16% accuracy on the 7,960-image curated AID benchmark), Flatsat validation, and live in-orbit captures of newly acquired, previously unseen Earth imagery (including uncorrected YAM-9 imagery, processed onboard with hardware-accelerated GPU inference and no fine-tuning for the flight instrument) demonstrate the feasibility of running foundation models on satellite-class edge computers to invert the conventional acquire-then-downlink-everything bandwidth profile through semantic compression of Earth observations in-orbit.

AI.tldr: NAVI-Orbital是首个在低地球轨道上实现视觉-语言模型完全自主多模态推理的软件系统，通过Gemma 3模型对地球观测图像进行语义压缩，用自然语言替代传统指令序列，实现了在轨实时分类、描述与对话交互，显著降低了数据传输需求。
AI.motivation: 地球观测数据生成速度远超下行带宽和人工处理能力，导致星上采集与地面情报之间存在巨大鸿沟，亟需一种能在轨自主处理和理解数据的方案。
AI.method: 在LEO卫星上部署NAVI-Orbital系统，使用本地视觉-语言模型Gemma 3进行场景分类、内容描述和特征关系分析，支持自然语言对话重任务，由基于图的LangGraph状态机协调多个专用智能体。
AI.result: 地面基准测试在7,960张AID数据集上达到88.16%准确率；通过了Flatsat验证；成功在轨运行，对YAM-9原始图像进行硬件加速GPU推理（无需微调）并生成语义描述。
AI.conclusion: 证明了在卫星级边缘计算机上运行基础模型的可行性，通过语义压缩方式颠覆传统"先采集再全量下行"的带宽使用模式，实现地球观测数据的在轨智能化处理。

title: CaVe-VLM-CoT: An Interpretable Vision-Language Model Framework
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) remain prone to hallucinations, producing fluent but visually unfaithful outputs. Existing chain-of-thought and retrieval-augmented methods only partially address this, as they neither enforce step-level citation grounding nor route verification failures back to retrieval for correction. We present CaVe-VLM-CoT, a modular reflection-based agentic-RAG framework that enforces evidence-grounded reasoning through a five-stage closed-loop pipeline: Extractor, Retriever, Solver, Citation Injector, and Verifier, in which detected ungrounded claims trigger structured feedback to the Extractor for targeted re-retrieval. Since no existing framework jointly measures retrieval quality, step-wise citation faithfulness, and cross-modal grounding, we propose a suite of 23 component-wise metrics across all stages, anchored by CaVeScore, a composite metric weighting accuracy, citation precision and recall, attribution, and evidence grounding. Without any architectural or prompt modifications, CaVe-VLM-CoT achieves 87.1\% accuracy and 56.6\% CaVeScore on ScienceQA , and 55.2\% accuracy and 35.7\% CaVeScore on MMMU (30 subjects).

AI.tldr: CaVe-VLM-CoT是一个模块化的反射式agentic-RAG框架，通过五阶段闭环流水线（提取器、检索器、求解器、引用注入器、验证器）强制证据基础推理，在ScienceQA和MMMU上分别取得87.1%/55.2%准确率和56.6%/35.7%CaVeScore。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM仍然存在幻觉问题，链式思维和检索增强方法未能强制执行步骤级引用验证，也无法将验证失败路由回检索进行修正。
AI.method: 提出CaVe-VLM-CoT框架，包含五阶段闭环：Extractor提取关键信息、Retriever检索证据、Solver推理求解、Citation Injector注入引用、Verifier验证并反馈未落地声明给Extractor触发重新检索。
AI.result: 在ScienceQA上准确率87.1%、CaVeScore 56.6%；在MMMU（30学科）上准确率55.2%、CaVeScore 35.7%。
AI.conclusion: 无需架构或提示修改，CaVe-VLM-CoT通过闭环验证-检索机制有效提升VLM的跨模态证据基础推理能力。

title: Data-Forcing Distillation: Restoring Diversity and Fidelity in Few-Step Video Generation
summary: Recent progress has shown promise in distilling multi-step video diffusion models into efficient few-step students. Among them, Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) and its successor DMD2 achieved strong generation quality and fast convergence. However, due to the nature of the reverse Kullback--Leibler (KL) objective, these methods exhibit two persistent failure modes: a substantial drop in sample diversity, and visibly over-saturated outputs that deviate from real-video appearance. In this work, we propose Data-Forcing Distillation (DFD), a simple post-training framework that restores diversity and fidelity in DMD with only a single-line of code change. At its core is the teacher score discrepancy to guide the student toward the real-data distribution, pulling it to missing modes (mitigating mode collapse) and away from problematic modes absent in real data (avoiding over-saturation). We provide an in-depth theoretical analysis of our framework and validate our approach on text-to-video, image-to-video, and autoregressive video generation. With only 100--300 steps of finetuning, DFD effectively restores diversity and fidelity on both Wan2.1-1.3B and Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B model, resolving the over-saturation artifacts with significantly better video dynamics and appearance, and even outperforms the teacher model.

AI.tldr: 提出Data-Forcing Distillation (DFD)框架，通过单行代码修改解决DMD蒸馏方法中的模式坍塌和过饱和问题，在文生视频、图生视频和自回归视频生成任务中恢复多样性和保真度。
AI.motivation: DMD及其变体在视频扩散模型蒸馏中因反向KL散度目标导致采样多样性下降和输出过饱和，偏离真实视频分布。
AI.method: 提出DFD框架，核心是教师分数差异（teacher score discrepancy）机制，引导学生模型向真实数据分布靠近，补充缺失模式并远离问题模式。
AI.result: 仅需100-300步微调，即可在Wan2.1-1.3B和Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B模型上有效恢复多样性和保真度，消除过饱和伪影，提升视频动态和外观，甚至超越教师模型。
AI.conclusion: DFD是一种简单有效的后训练框架，通过单行代码修改即可显著提升蒸馏模型的质量。

title: Searching for Synergy in Shared Workspace Human-AI Collaboration
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 Workshop on Human-AI Co-Creativity. 13 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables
summary: Automated AI agents are increasingly capable, yet many scientific and professional tasks require human judgment and contextual expertise. We study shared-workspace human-AI teams, where AI agents and human collaborators must coordinate responsibilities before submitting a final answer. Using the Collaborative Gym environment with DiscoveryBench tasks, we examine when adding simulated human collaborators improves performance and when process loss turns additional collaborators into coordination overhead. Across 1,482 sessions, adding relevant collaborators can lower performance when teams lack structure to coordinate their contributions. We then evaluate scaffolding that combines shared group memory with simulated human-in-the-loop (HITL) gates, where selected actions require approval from a designated simulated participant. This scaffolding yields higher mean performance, most clearly in three-person teams, with clearer responsibility signals and stronger routing of expertise to team actions. Overall, how human-AI teams coordinate and integrate expertise matters as much as the capability available to them.

AI.tldr: 在共享工作空间的人机协作团队中，添加模拟人类协作者并不总能提升性能，缺乏协调结构反而会造成过程损失；通过结合共享组记忆和模拟人机交互门控的支架设计，能显著提升三人团队的绩效，关键在于更好的责任信号和专业知识路由。
AI.motivation: 虽然AI智能体能力日益增强，但许多科学和专业任务仍需人类判断和上下文专业知识。研究者希望探索人机共享工作区团队中，如何有效协调AI智能体与人类协作者的职责分配。
AI.method: 使用Collaborative Gym环境与DiscoveryBench任务，进行了1,482次会话实验。对比了添加模拟人类协作者与无结构协作两种场景，并评估了结合共享组记忆与模拟人机交互门控的支架方法。
AI.result: 添加相关协作者但缺乏协调结构会降低性能；而采用共享组记忆+HITL门控的支架设计在三人团队中表现最佳，实现了更清晰的责任信号和更强的专业知识路由。
AI.conclusion: 人机团队的协调方式和专业知识整合能力，与团队所拥有的能力本身同样重要。

title: SproutRAG: Attention-Guided Tree Search with Progressive Embeddings for Long-Document RAG
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems must balance retrieval granularity with contextual coherence, a challenge that existing methods address through LLM-guided chunking, single-level context expansion, or hierarchical summarization. These approaches variously depend on costly LLM calls during indexing or retrieval, limit context aggregation to a single granularity level, or introduce information loss through summarization. We present SproutRAG, an attention-guided hierarchical RAG framework that addresses this trade-off by organizing sentence-level chunks into progressively larger but semantically coherent units, using learned inter-sentence attention to construct a binary chunking tree. Unlike prior approaches that rely on external LLMs, fixed context expansion, or lossy summarization, SproutRAG learns which attention heads and layers best capture semantic document structure, enabling multi-granularity retrieval without additional LLM calls or compressed summaries. At retrieval time, SproutRAG uses hierarchical beam search to retrieve candidates at multiple granularities, capturing multi-sentence relevance beyond flat retrieval. The framework is trained end-to-end with a joint objective that improves both embeddings and tree structure. Experiments across four benchmarks spanning scientific, legal, and open-domain settings demonstrate that SproutRAG improves information efficiency (IE) by 6.1% on average over the strongest baseline. Code is available on https://github.com/AmirAbaskohi/SproutRAG.

AI.tldr: SproutRAG提出了一种基于注意力引导的层次化RAG框架，通过构建二分块树实现多粒度检索，无需额外LLM调用或摘要压缩，在四个基准上平均提升信息效率6.1%。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG系统在检索粒度与上下文连贯性之间存在权衡，现有方法依赖昂贵的LLM调用、单一粒度扩展或有损摘要，需要一种更高效的层次化检索方案。
AI.method: 利用学习的句子间注意力构建二分块树，将句子级块组织为语义连贯的更大单元；通过层次化束搜索进行多粒度检索；采用联合目标函数端到端训练嵌入和树结构。
AI.result: 在科学、法律和开放域四个基准上，平均信息效率(IE)比最强基线提升6.1%。
AI.conclusion: SproutRAG通过注意力引导的层次化结构，在不增加LLM调用或信息损失的前提下，有效平衡了检索粒度与上下文连贯性。

title: Vines-DB: An RGB image dataset for multi-species ornamental vine segmentation
comment: 7 pages, 1 figure. Source data repository: OSF (DOI: 10.17605/OSF.IO/YJHCK)
summary: The Vines-DB dataset contains 1,218 original high-resolution RGB images of seven ornamental vine species collected under field conditions at the Utah Agricultural Experiment Station's Greenville Research Farm in Logan, Utah, USA. The dataset was generated from 168 individual vine plants that were transplanted in 2022 and photographed repeatedly across multiple months during the 2023 and 2024 growing seasons (July-October). Images were captured with an iPhone 16 Pro equipped with a 48 MP camera between 10:00 AM and 12:00 PM under daylight. Vines were grown on 1.2m x 2.4m trellises and photographed from a distance of 1m against black or white Styrofoam backdrops to improve contrast and reduce background noise. The dataset includes Akebia quinata, Campsis radicans, Hydrangea anomala petiolaris, Lonicera x heckrottii, Campsis x tagliabuana 'Madame Galen', Parthenocissus quinquefolia, and Wisteria floribunda. All original images were manually annotated in Roboflow by trained annotators to produce polygon-based instance segmentation masks for eight classes, including seven species and background. After preprocessing and data augmentation, the working dataset was expanded to 2,307 images for model development and evaluation. The augmented dataset was divided into 2,019 training images, 192 validation images, and 96 test images using stratified sampling to maintain balanced representation. Vines-DB supports the development and evaluation of deep learning models for multi-class instance segmentation in precision horticulture and urban ecology. The dataset enables applications such as automated canopy cover estimation, species identification, and scalable field phenotyping. In addition, repeated monthly imaging of the plants captures temporal variation in canopy development and plant appearance, increasing the dataset's utility for segmentation benchmarking under realistic field conditions.

AI.tldr: Vines-DB是一个包含1,218张高分辨率RGB图像的数据集，涵盖7种观赏藤本植物，经过标注和增强后扩展至2,307张图像，用于支持精准 horticulture 和城市生态中的深度学习实例分割模型开发。
AI.motivation: 为精准 horticulture 和城市生态领域提供专门针对藤本植物的多类实例分割数据集，填补现有数据集在藤本植物物种识别和 canopy 覆盖估计方面的空白。
AI.method: 在田间条件下，使用iPhone 16 Pro（48 MP）在2023-2024年生长季（7-10月）每月拍摄168株藤本植物；使用黑白泡沫板背景提高对比度；在Roboflow中由训练有素的标注员进行多边形实例分割标注；通过数据增强将原始1,218张图像扩展至2,307张，并按分层抽样划分为训练集（2,019张）、验证集（192张）和测试集（96张）。
AI.result: 构建了包含7种藤本植物（Akebia quinata等）和背景共8个类别的实例分割数据集，原始图像1,218张，增强后2,307张，并完成训练/验证/测试集划分。
AI.conclusion: Vines-DB可用于自动化 canopy 覆盖估计、物种识别和可扩展的田间表型分析等应用，其月度重复成像捕获了 canopy 发育的时间变化，增强了在现实田间条件下进行分割基准测试的实用性。

title: Want Better Synthetic Data? Steer It: Activation Steering for Low-Resource Language Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have become an effective tool for synthetic data generation, including for low-resource languages, where generated data can improve downstream task performance. Current best-performing approaches typically rely on few-shot prompting with target-language examples, which increases inference costs and may reduce diversity through lexical anchoring. In this work, we investigate activation steering as an alternative for low-resource synthetic data generation. We study two steering strategies: Language Steering, which targets the linguistic identity of a language, and Quality Steering, which captures well-formedness by contrasting human-written and backtranslated text representations. We evaluate these methods across four open-source LLMs, multiple layers, and 11 typologically diverse languages by generating sentiment and topic classification data and finetuning smaller classifiers. Steering is applied in both zero-shot and few-shot prompting settings and compared against non-steered counterparts. Our results show that steering on early layers consistently improves the diversity of generated data while often yielding stronger downstream model performance, particularly for low-resource languages.

AI.tldr: 本文研究使用激活引导（activation steering）作为低资源语言合成数据生成的替代方法，通过语言引导和质量引导两种策略，在早期层进行引导能持续提升生成数据的多样性，并在下游任务中取得更好性能。
AI.motivation: 现有低资源语言合成数据生成方法多依赖少样本提示（few-shot prompting），这增加了推理成本且可能因词汇锚定降低多样性。因此需要探索更高效、多样化的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出两种激活引导策略：语言引导（Language Steering）针对语言身份特征，质量引导（Quality Steering）通过对比人工撰写与回译文本的表征捕捉文本规范性。在4个开源LLM、多个层和11种语言上生成情感分类和主题分类数据，微调小规模分类器进行评估。
AI.result: 早期层引导持续提升生成数据的多样性，并在下游任务中取得更强的模型性能，尤其对低资源语言效果显著。
AI.conclusion: 激活引导是少样本提示的有效替代方案，能提升低资源语言合成数据的多样性和下游性能。

title: Neural Phase Correlation
summary:
Correspondence is fundamentally relational: it seeks the unknown transformation between two observations of a common scene, not the content of either. Yet the dominant learning-based methods do not represent the transformation as a first-class object in the architecture. They encode each image independently and let a learned similarity function or a deep decoder discover the mapping implicitly. Phase correlation is the canonical exception, measuring the inter-image relationship directly in the Fourier domain, but the rigidity of its fixed basis confines it to global translation.
  We introduce a learned generalization of phase correlation that lifts this restriction by learning the basis on which the transformation decomposes. The same algebraic primitive extends to dense non-rigid deformations and to unitary dynamics. On the ACDC cardiac-MRI benchmark the framework matches or exceeds prior published baselines on both registration directions. On CAMUS echocardiography it matches state-of-the-art without auxiliary scoring or adaptive-smoothness mechanisms. Applied to time-evolved wavefunction pairs of the 1-D quantum harmonic oscillator, the same framework recovers the Hermite-function eigenstates and the quantized energy levels of the unknown Hamiltonian from observation pairs alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种学习广义相位相关的方法，通过可学习基函数取代固定傅里叶基，将变换关系作为一等对象建模，适用于密集非刚性变形和幺正动力学，在医学图像配准和量子系统观测中取得优异效果。
AI.motivation: 现有基于学习的图像对应方法将每张图像独立编码，通过相似度函数或解码器隐式学习变换关系，而非将变换本身作为架构中的一等对象。尽管相位相关直接在傅里叶域度量图像间关系，但其固定基的刚性限制了它仅能处理全局平移。本文旨在克服这一限制。
AI.method: 提出相位相关的学习泛化版本：通过学习可变的基函数取代固定的傅里叶基，使得变换可以在该基上进行分解。该方法可扩展到密集非刚性形变和幺正动力学场景。
AI.result: 在ACDC心脏MRI基准上，两个配准方向均匹配或超越已有基线；在CAMUS超声心动图上，无需辅助评分或自适应平滑机制即达到最先进水平；在1D量子谐振子的时间演化波函数对上，仅从观测对中恢复了Hermite函数本征态和量子化能级。
AI.conclusion: 通过学习基函数泛化相位相关，成功将变换关系作为一等对象引入学习架构，突破了固定傅里叶基仅处理全局平移的限制，并在医学图像配准和物理系统逆向推理中证明了该框架的有效性。

title: DeFAb: A Verifiable Benchmark for Defeasible Abduction in Foundation Models
comment: 33 pages, 14 figures, 23 tables. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/PatrickAllenCooper/DeFAb ; code and evaluation harness: https://github.com/PatrickAllenCooper/blanc
summary: A rule-based logic solver resolves every instance in our benchmark in under 50 microseconds with 100% accuracy; the best frontier language model reaches 65% at best and drops to 23.5% under rendering-robust evaluation (worst case over four surface renderings). We introduce DeFAb (Defeasible Abduction Benchmark), a dataset and generation pipeline that converts four decades of publicly funded knowledge bases into formally grounded instances for defeasible abduction: constructing hypotheses that explain anomalies by overriding defaults while preserving unrelated expectations. Because every hypothesis must pass polynomial-time checks for valid derivation, conservativity, and minimality, DeFAb makes logical rigor the instrument for measuring creativity and theoretical reasoning, scoring the disciplined construction of theory revisions rather than fluent but theory-destroying prose. The pipeline pairs taxonomic hierarchies (OpenCyc, YAGO, Wikidata) with behavioral property graphs (ConceptNet, UMLS) to produce 372,648+ instances across 33.75M materialized rules from 18 sources, in three levels with polynomial-time verifiable gold standards. Four frontier models do not reliably internalize defeasible reasoning: rendering-robust Level 2 accuracy is 7.8-23.5%; chain-of-thought variance (~36 pp) exceeds any inter-model gap; and a matched contamination control isolates a +19.4 pp Level 3 gap. We further release DeFAb-Hard (a 235-instance Level 3 difficulty variant; best model 53.3% vs 100% symbolic) and CONJURE (a kernel-verified transformative-creativity variant of 560 Lean 4/Mathlib instances whose gold answers are definitions the proof kernel did not previously contain, judge-free verifier; a pilot finds zero novel concepts). The same verifier doubles as an exact reward for preference optimization (DPO, RLVR/GRPO). Released under MIT at https://huggingface.co/datasets/PatrickAllenCooper/DeFAb.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DeFAb（可废止溯因基准），一个将四十年公共知识库转化为形式化可废止溯因推理实例的数据集与生成管线。符号求解器在50微秒内实现100%准确率，而最强前沿语言模型最高仅65%，在鲁棒渲染评估下降至23.5%。同时发布DeFAb-Hard和CONJURE（基于Lean 4的形式化创造力变体），并开源MIT协议。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型在需要严谨逻辑推理的创造性任务（如通过覆盖默认规则来解释异常现象）上表现不佳，因为流畅的自然语言生成可能掩盖理论破坏性。作者希望通过形式化逻辑约束来量化评估模型的创造力和理论推理能力。
AI.method: 1) 构建DeFAb管线：将OpenCyc、YAGO、Wikidata等分类层次与ConceptNet、UMLS等行为属性图结合，生成372,648+个可废止溯因实例，涵盖18个来源的33.75M条物化规则。2) 所有假设必须通过多项式时间验证（有效推导、保守性、最小性）。3) 设置三个难度级别，金标准可多项式时间验证。4) 设计CONJURE变体：将问题转化为Lean 4/Mathlib形式，由证明内核验证答案是否为全新定义。
AI.result: 1) 符号求解器：100%准确率，<50微秒/实例。2) 四大前沿模型：鲁棒评估下Level 2准确率仅7.8-23.5%；思维链方差(约36个百分点)超过模型间最大差距。3) 污染控制实验：发现+19.4个百分点的Level 3差距。4) DeFAb-Hard：最佳模型53.3% vs 符号系统100%。5) CONJURE试点：零新概念发现。
AI.conclusion: 前沿语言模型未能可靠内化可废止推理能力。DeFAb通过形式化验证为衡量AI的创造性和理论推理提供了严谨标尺，其验证器还可直接作为偏好优化（DPO、RLVR/GRPO）的奖励函数。

title: JetFlow: Breaking the Scaling Ceiling of Speculative Decoding with Parallel Tree Drafting
summary: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates autoregressive Large Language Models (LLMs) by drafting multiple tokens and verifying them in parallel, but it faces a scaling limitation: increasing the draft budget improves speed only when acceptance remains high and drafting overhead stays low. This ceiling has been difficult to break because prior head-based SD methods face a causality-efficiency dilemma. Autoregressive drafters produce path-conditioned candidates that are effective for tree speculative decoding with higher acceptance length, but their drafting cost grows with tree depth. Bidirectional block-diffusion drafters generate all positions in one pass, but their branch-agnostic marginals can form individually plausible yet mutually inconsistent trees, wasting budget and reducing acceptance. We propose JetFlow, a head-based SD framework that combines one-forward drafting efficiency with branch-wise causal conditioning. JetFlow trains a causal parallel draft head over fused hidden states from the frozen target model, producing candidate trees whose scores align with the target model's autoregressive factorization. This enables JetFlow to convert larger draft budgets into longer accepted prefixes and higher end-to-end speedup. Across math, coding, and chat benchmarks on dense and MoE Qwen3 models, JetFlow consistently outperforms bidirectional-head and tree-based SD baselines. On H100 GPUs, JetFlow achieves up to 9.64x speedup on MATH-500 and 4.58x on open-ended conversational workloads, with further latency gains demonstrated through vLLM integration under realistic serving loads. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/hao-ai-lab/JetFlow.

AI.tldr: JetFlow是一种基于头部的投机解码框架，通过因果并行草稿头结合冻结目标模型的融合隐藏状态，实现了草案预算向更长接受前缀和更高端到端加速的有效转化，在Qwen3模型上最高达到9.64倍加速。
AI.motivation: 现有投机解码方法面临可扩展性瓶颈：自回归草案器随树深度增加开销大，双向块扩散草案器产生分支无关的边缘分布导致树不一致、浪费预算。两类方法难以兼顾高效性与因果条件性。
AI.method: JetFlow在冻结目标模型的融合隐藏状态上训练一个因果并行草稿头，一次性前向传播生成候选树，且候选树的得分与目标模型的自回归分解对齐，兼顾了单次前向的高效性和分支级别的因果条件性。
AI.result: 在密集和MoE Qwen3模型的数学、编程和对话基准上，JetFlow优于双向头及基于树的SD基线。在H100 GPU上，MATH-500达到9.64倍加速，开放对话任务达4.58倍加速，vLLM集成下进一步降低延迟。
AI.conclusion: JetFlow通过因果并行草稿头有效打破了投机解码的可扩展性天花板，将更大草案预算转化为更长接受序列和更高加速比，代码和模型已开源。

title: Architectural Bias in Face Presentation Attack Detection: A Comparative Study of Vision Transformers and Convolutional Neural Networks
summary: Face Presentation Attack Detection (PAD) systems constitute a critical security layer in biometric authentication; however, existing approaches exhibit systematic performance disparities across demographic groups, disproportionately affecting individuals with darker skin tones. This paper presents a comparative empirical investigation of whether Vision Transformer architectures reduce demographic bias in face PAD systems relative to convolutional baselines. Experiments are conducted on the CASIA-SURF Cross-Ethnicity Face Anti-Spoofing (CeFA) dataset. Three architectures are evaluated: a Multimodal ViT-Tiny trained from scratch, a ResNet18 CNN baseline, and a pretrained DeiT-S fine-tuned on CeFA across African, East Asian, and zero-shot Central Asian demographic groups. DeiT-S achieves the highest overall accuracy of 97.27% and the lowest EER of 0.86%, outperforming ResNet18 at 90.15% accuracy. In terms of fairness, DeiT-S reduces the inter-ethnic ACER gap between African and East Asian subjects to 0.13%, compared to 0.75% reported in an LBP-based work [6], representing an 83% reduction. Most notably, while ResNet18 records a BPCER of 10.44% on zero-shot Central Asian subjects, DeiT-S maintains 2.89% on the same unseen group, demonstrating a 3.6x generalization advantage. These results suggest that pretrained Vision Transformers achieve superior PAD accuracy, produce smaller demographic performance gaps, and generalize more equitably across unseen demographic groups, indicating that cross-demographic fairness in PAD may partly be influenced by architectural design.

AI.tldr: 本文对比研究了Vision Transformer（ViT）与CNN在面部呈现攻击检测（PAD）中的表现，发现预训练的DeiT-S在CASIA-SURF CeFA数据集上不仅准确率最高（97.27%），还能显著减少跨种族性能差距（种族间ACER差距降低83%），并在未见过的中亚群体上展现出3.6倍的泛化优势，表明架构选择对PAD系统的跨人口公平性有重要影响。
AI.motivation: 现有面部PAD系统在不同人口群体间存在系统性性能差异，尤其是对深肤色人群影响更大，因此需要探究是否可以通过改变模型架构（如采用Vision Transformer）来减少这种人口统计学偏差。
AI.method: 在CASIA-SURF CeFA跨种族人脸防欺骗数据集上，对比了三种架构：从头训练的Multimodal ViT-Tiny、ResNet18 CNN基线、以及预训练的DeiT-S（在CeFA上微调）。评估涵盖非洲、东亚及零样本中亚人口群体。
AI.result: DeiT-S最高准确率97.27%，最低EER 0.86%，优于ResNet18的90.15%。DeiT-S将非洲与东亚人群间的ACER差距降至0.13%（相比LBP方法的0.75%降低83%）。在零样本中亚群体上，DeiT-S的BPCER为2.89%，而ResNet18高达10.44%，泛化优势达3.6倍。
AI.conclusion: 预训练Vision Transformer在面部PAD中不仅准确率更高，还能产生更小的人口统计学性能差距，并在未见过的群体上实现更公平的泛化，表明跨人口公平性部分受到架构设计的影响。

title: Optimizing Lithium Production Decisions under Geological, Demand, and Pricing Uncertainties: A POMDP Framework for Multi-Objective Decision Making
summary: Decision making in lithium production is challenging, whether from an investor's perspective or a strategic production standpoint. Determining which mines to open and when to open them involves not only geological and price uncertainties, but also complexities around the choice of extraction method, from direct lithium extraction to hard rock mining. Prior work explored models of this problem and different methods to optimize mining decisions; these models did not account for uncertainty in pricing, uncertainty in demand, or different mining technologies to extract lithium. Incorporating different pricing models and extraction technology into these models enables more robust strategies for determining not only when and where to open a mine, but also which method of production to pursue. We frame the problem as a partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP) and solve using belief state planning methods to get optimal decision making. In our study, we show that POMDP solvers outperform human inspired heuristics by dynamically adapting to shifting lithium price regimes (static, linear, exponential, and stochastic) through belief state planning and explicit uncertainty management. By optimally sequencing exploration, production, and technology choice, the framework achieves higher demand fulfillment and more balanced economic environmental outcomes over the projects lifetime in all different pricing and deposit scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将锂生产决策问题建模为部分可观察马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），通过信念状态规划方法优化矿山开采时机、地点及提取技术的选择，在多种价格和需求不确定条件下优于人类启发式策略。
AI.motivation: 锂生产决策面临地质、价格不确定性和提取技术选择（直接提锂vs硬岩开采）等复杂挑战，现有模型未考虑价格不确定性、需求不确定性及不同开采技术，需要更鲁棒的决策框架。
AI.method: 将锂生产决策问题建模为部分可观察马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），采用信念状态规划方法求解，在静态、线性、指数和随机四种价格机制下进行优化。
AI.result: POMDP求解器通过动态适应价格变化和显式不确定性管理，在所有价格和矿床场景下均优于人类启发式启发策略，实现了更高的需求满足度和更均衡的经济环境效益。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过最优地排序勘探、生产和技术选择，能够在项目全生命周期内实现更优的决策效果，为锂生产决策提供了有效的优化方法。

title: CoreMem: Riemannian Retrieval and Fisher-Guided Distillation for Long-Term Memory in Dialogue Agents
summary: Personalized dialogue agents require continuous long-term memory to maintain coherent interactions across multiple sessions. However, deploying these capabilities on consumer-grade hardware (e.g., 8 GB VRAM edge devices) introduces severe memory and compute bottlenecks. Existing systems typically rely on isotropic cosine similarity for retrieval and heuristic rules for context compression. These approaches lack a unified theoretical foundation, frequently suffering from the hubness problem in high-dimensional retrieval and syntactic fragmentation during compression. To overcome these limitations, we propose CoreMem, a resource-efficient edge-cloud memory architecture fundamentally unified by information geometry. First, Riemannian retrieval replaces cosine matching with a locally adaptive Fisher-Rao metric, effectively penalizing hub memories via Mahalanobis distance with O(Ndr) Woodbury acceleration for real-time search. Second, Fisher-guided discrete token distillation (FDTD) introduces a hierarchical sentence-to-token compression mechanism. It derives sensitivity scores from Fisher information traces, providing a principled compression-KL tradeoff augmented with explicit structural syntax protection. Evaluated on the LOCOMO and LongMemEval-S benchmarks, CoreMem achieves strong accuracy improvements, yielding substantial gains in Open-domain (+4.51 pp) and Temporal (+4.17 pp) reasoning. Extensive profiling confirms that CoreMem operates seamlessly within a strict 8 GB VRAM budget, successfully bridging the gap between resource-constrained edge devices and the demand for theoretically grounded, lifelong memory agents.

AI.tldr: CoreMem是一种基于信息几何的资源高效边缘-云记忆架构，通过Riemannian检索和Fisher引导的离散令牌蒸馏，在8GB VRAM限制下实现了对话记忆性能的显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有个性化对话智能体在消费级硬件上部署时面临内存和计算瓶颈，且现有方法缺乏统一理论框架，存在高维检索中的hubness问题和压缩中的句法碎片化问题。
AI.method: 提出CoreMem架构，包含两个核心组件：(1) Riemannian检索——用Fisher-Rao度量替代余弦相似度，通过Mahalanobis距离和Woodbury加速实现实时搜索；(2) Fisher引导的离散令牌蒸馏(FDTD)——从Fisher信息迹推导敏感度分数，实现层次化句子到令牌的压缩，并加入结构语法保护。
AI.result: 在LOCOMO和LongMemEval-S基准上，Open-domain推理提升4.51个百分点，Temporal推理提升4.17个百分点，且严格限制在8GB VRAM预算内运行。
AI.conclusion: CoreMem成功弥合了资源受限的边缘设备与追求理论扎实、终身记忆的智能体之间的差距。

title: A Prototypical Signature Approach for Writer-Independent Offline Signature Verification
comment: Accepted for oral presentation at the International Conference on Pattern Recognition (ICPR) 2026
summary: Offline handwritten signature verification aims to distinguish genuine from forged signatures using static images. Since real forgeries are rarely available, negative samples are usually randomly drawn from genuine signatures of other users to create training data. However, this random selection often lacks diversity, increases redundancy, and escalates computational cost, leading to inefficient training. We propose a data-driven strategy to generate diverse, informative negative samples using prototypical signatures, which are compact, non-identifiable summaries of genuine signature features. Based on the experiments results, we conclude that (i) prototypical signatures yield more informative negative samples, improving the detection of skilled forgeries; (ii) the proposed approach is backbone-agnostic, showing robustness across architectures; and (iii) when combined with a primal-form linear SVM, it serves as an alternative to RBF-based models while significantly improving scalability and computational efficiency. Implementation of the method is available at https://github.com/kdmoura/proto_hsv.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于原型签名（prototypical signatures）的数据驱动策略，用于生成多样化、信息丰富的负样本，以提升离线手写签名验证的性能。该方法与线性SVM结合可替代RBF模型，显著提高计算效率，且与多种骨干网络兼容。
AI.motivation: 现有方法随机从其他用户的真实签名中选取负样本，存在多样性不足、冗余度高、计算成本大等问题，导致训练效率低下。
AI.method: 提出利用原型签名（prototypical signatures）——一种紧凑、不可识别的真实签名特征摘要——来生成多样化且信息量大的负样本。
AI.result: 实验表明：(i)原型签名能生成更具信息量的负样本，提升对熟练伪造签名的检测能力；(ii)该方法与多种骨干网络兼容，具有鲁棒性；(iii)与线性SVM结合可作为RBF模型的替代方案，显著提升可扩展性和计算效率。
AI.conclusion: 基于原型签名的负样本生成策略能有效解决传统随机采样的问题，提升签名验证性能，同时保持计算高效和架构无关性。

title: ForecastBench-Sim: A Simulated-World Forecasting Benchmark
comment: 15 pages, 5 main figures, 6 appendix figures. Spotlight presentation at Forecasting as a New Frontier of Intelligence / Workshop on AI Forecasting, ICML 2026
summary: Forecasting benchmarks for general-purpose AI systems usually inherit the constraints of the real world: outcomes resolve slowly, tail events are rare, and counterfactual questions are difficult to score. We introduce ForecastBench-Sim, a simulated-world forecasting benchmark built on game rollouts from Freeciv, a turn-based strategy game modelled on the Civilization series. Forecasters receive a fixed world report (a structured snapshot of the current game state) and answer questions about hidden future states; the benchmark then continues the simulation and scores forecasts. Because the world is simulated, the same setup can generate continuous or binary forecasting questions at arbitrary time horizons, paired intervention worlds for conditional or causal questions, and resolved examples of rare or disruptive outcomes. We describe the benchmark pipeline, question families, scoring protocol, and release artifacts, and report validation slices from model evaluations and an anonymized human pilot. ForecastBench-Sim is intended to complement real-world forecasting benchmarks by providing controlled, immediately resolvable tasks for studying probabilistic reasoning under dynamic world states.

AI.tldr: 提出基于《Freeciv》策略游戏的模拟世界预测基准ForecastBench-Sim，通过游戏回滚生成可控、可即时解析的预测任务，补充现实世界预测基准在反馈延迟、罕见事件和反事实问题上的不足。
AI.motivation: 现实世界预测基准存在结果解析缓慢、尾部事件罕见、反事实问题难以评分等局限，需要一种可控制、可即时验证的模拟环境来研究概率推理能力。
AI.method: 基于《Freeciv》策略游戏构建模拟世界；从游戏状态快照生成未来预测问题；通过游戏继续模拟并评分预测；支持连续/二值预测、任意时间跨度、条件/因果干预世界以及罕见事件样本。
AI.result: 构建了完整的基准流程、问题族、评分协议；发布了验证集切片及模型评估和匿名人类试点结果。
AI.conclusion: ForecastBench-Sim作为真实世界预测基准的补充，提供受控、可即时解析的任务，用于研究动态世界状态下的概率推理。

title: VISUALSKILL: Multimodal Skills for Computer-Use Agents
summary: Computer-use agents (CUAs) approach human-level performance on standardised benchmarks but still struggle on long-horizon tasks and unseen software. Existing skill libraries address this with reusable skills, but represent the skill artifact as text only, despite the visual nature of GUI interaction. We propose VISUALSKILL: a hierarchical multimodal skill, tailored to each target application and organised as a central index over per-topic files, which the agent consumes through a load_topic MCP tool that fetches the relevant topic's text and figures on demand. We construct each skill with a two-stage pipeline that combines authored documentation with live-application UI exploration. On two CUA benchmarks, CUA-World and OSExpert-Eval, a Claude Code CLI agent backed by Claude Opus 4.6 reaches an average score of 0.456 with VISUALSKILL, a +15.3 point absolute lift over the no-skill baseline (0.303). Against a matched text-only skill that is generated from the same source content and differs from VISUALSKILL only in modality, VISUALSKILL yields a further +8.3 point absolute gain over the matched text-only skill (0.373 vs. 0.456), providing direct evidence that retaining visual figures in the skill artifact, rather than verbalizing them away, helps the agent both identify UI elements and verify workflow state after each action. Our code is available at https://github.com/XMHZZ2018/VisualSkills.

AI.tldr: 提出VISUALSKILL——一种分层多模态技能库，通过保留GUI交互中的视觉信息（文本+图像），显著提升计算机使用代理在长周期任务和未知软件上的表现，相比纯文本技能带来+8.3个百分点的绝对提升。
AI.motivation: 现有计算机使用代理在标准化基准上接近人类水平，但在长周期任务和未见过的软件上仍存在困难。现有技能库虽能复用技能，但仅以文本形式表示技能工件，忽略了GUI交互的视觉本质。
AI.method: 提出VISUALSKILL分层多模态技能结构，按主题组织索引，通过load_topic MCP工具按需获取相关主题的文本和图像。采用两阶段流水线构建：编写文档+实时应用UI探索。在Claude Code CLI代理（Claude Opus 4.6）上进行评估。
AI.result: 在CUA-World和OSExpert-Eval两个基准上，VISUALSKILL平均得分0.456，比无技能基线（0.303）提升+15.3个百分点；比匹配的纯文本技能（0.373）提升+8.3个百分点，验证了保留视觉图像的直接优势。
AI.conclusion: 保留技能工件中的视觉图像（而非将其文本化）能帮助代理更好地识别UI元素和验证工作流状态，证明了多模态技能在GUI代理中的有效性。

title: Hierarchical Multi-Modal Retrieval for Knowledge-Grounded News Image Captioning
summary: Traditional image captioning methods often struggle to generate comprehensive, context-rich descriptions, especially for details not directly observable from visual cues. To overcome this, we propose a novel retrieval-augmented image captioning framework that generates captions with deeper insights, such as object attributes, event context, and underlying significance, by leveraging external knowledge. Our approach features a hierarchical multi-modal article retrieval mechanism that moves beyond monolithic text entities. This retrieval considers article structure-aware features, including weighted textual components (e.g., headlines, body sections) and visual placement patterns, alongside multi-faceted similarity computations (content--visual, visual--visual, and discourse positioning). A subsequent contextual relevance refinement stage further enhances the retrieved information. The retrieved articles then serve as the knowledge base for caption generation: first, a VLM generates a concise image description; second, we segment relevant information from the retrieved articles based on this description; and finally, an LLM utilizes both the description and extracted knowledge to generate a comprehensive, contextually detailed caption. We participated in the ACM Multimedia EVENTA 2025 Challenge and achieved 5th place with an overall score of 0.2824 on the private test set of the OpenEvent-V1 dataset. Source code is publicly released at https://github.com/mf0212/EVENTA-Challange.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种检索增强的图像描述框架，通过分层多模态文章检索和上下文相关性精炼，利用外部知识生成包含对象属性、事件背景和深层意义的丰富描述，在ACM Multimedia EVENTA 2025挑战赛中取得第5名。
AI.motivation: 传统图像描述方法难以生成全面、上下文丰富的描述，尤其对于无法直接从视觉线索中观察到的细节信息。
AI.method: 提出检索增强框架，包含：1) 分层多模态文章检索机制，考虑文章结构特征（加权文本组件、视觉布局模式）和多面相似度计算（内容-视觉、视觉-视觉、语篇定位）；2) 上下文相关性精炼阶段；3) 两阶段生成：VLM生成简洁描述后，LLM结合描述和检索知识生成全面描述。
AI.result: 在ACM Multimedia EVENTA 2025挑战赛OpenEvent-V1数据集的私有测试集上取得第5名，总体得分为0.2824。
AI.conclusion: 提出的检索增强框架能有效利用外部知识生成更丰富的图像描述，超越了仅依赖视觉线索的传统方法。

title: What Must Generalist Agents Remember?
summary: This paper develops a formal account of what generalist agents must store in memory in order to act near-optimally across multiple environments and goals. It shows that when two domains share an observational bottleneck but require incompatible optimal actions, any uniformly near-optimal policy must induce distinct memory distributions at that bottleneck. The result yields a separation theorem: sufficiently successful agents cannot rely only on current state observations, but must preserve domain-relevant information in memory. The paper further shows that if an agent's memory contains enough information to estimate values for related goals, then that memory can be used to approximately reconstruct the agent's local transition dynamics. Together, these results characterize memory as the substrate that supports domain disambiguation, transition-model reconstruction, and planning for generalist agents.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论上论证了通才型智能体必须在记忆中存储领域相关信息才能在不同环境和目标下实现近最优行为，并提出了分离定理和记忆构建转换动力学的性质。
AI.motivation: 为通才型智能体为何需要记忆提供正式的理论基础，解释记忆对于跨环境、跨目标近最优决策的必要性。
AI.method: 通过观察瓶颈和不相容最优动作的理论分析，证明近最优策略必须在瓶颈处产生不同的记忆分布；进一步分析记忆信息与价值估计、转换动力学重构之间的关系。
AI.result: 证明了分离定理：成功的智能体不能仅依赖当前观测，必须保留领域相关信息在记忆中；且记忆信息足以近似重构局部转换动力学。
AI.conclusion: 记忆是通才型智能体实现领域区分、转换模型重建和规划的核心支撑机制。

title: LLM Parameters for Math Across Languages: Shared or Separate?
comment: 5 pages. Accepted at ACL Student Research Workshop (SRW) 2026. Code: https://github.com/luisavictor/math-across-languages Translated Datasets: https://huggingface.co/math-across-languages Webpage: https://math-across-languages.github.io
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit substantial cross-lingual variation in mathematical reasoning performance, but it remains unclear whether these differences reflect language-specific parameters or a shared mechanism that manifests differently by language. We present a cross-lingual mechanistic analysis of mathematical reasoning in LLMs, enabling us to localize and compare model parameters that support mathematical reasoning across languages. We find that the extracted math-associated parameters exhibit partial cross-lingual overlap, with the strongest overlap concentrated in intermediate model layers. We further observe that English consistently produces the largest set of math-relevant parameters, whereas lower-resource languages reveal smaller sets of relevant parameters. These results suggest that math-related behavior in multilingual LLMs is neither fully language-invariant nor fully language-specific, but instead exhibits partial cross-lingual parameter overlap with systematic language-dependent differences.

AI.tldr: 大型语言模型在数学推理上存在跨语言差异，研究发现数学相关参数部分跨语言重叠，主要集中在中层，英语参数最多，低资源语言较少，表明机制既非完全语言无关也非完全语言特定。
AI.motivation: 探究LLM在数学推理中的跨语言差异究竟源于语言特定参数还是共享机制在不同语言上的不同表现。
AI.method: 对LLM进行跨语言机制分析，定位并比较支持不同语言数学推理的模型参数。
AI.result: 数学相关参数存在部分跨语言重叠，集中在中间层；英语有最多的数学相关参数，低资源语言参数集较小。
AI.conclusion: 多语言LLM中的数学推理行为既非完全语言无关也非完全语言特定，而是呈现部分跨语言参数重叠且存在系统性语言依赖差异。

title: Forged Calamity: Benchmark for Cross-Domain Synthetic Disaster Detection in the Age of Diffusion
summary: The rapid advancement of text-to-image diffusion models has enabled the creation of highly photorealistic synthetic images that closely resemble real photographs, making it increasingly difficult to distinguish authentic content from AI-generated fabrications. This poses challenges for cybersecurity, digital forensics, and disaster response, where fake imagery of floods, fires, or earthquakes can spread misinformation or disrupt emergency operations. To address this, we introduce Forged Calamity, a benchmark dataset for synthetic disaster detection containing 30,000 images, including 6,000 real and 24,000 synthetic samples generated by four diffusion models. Comprehensive experiments across fine-tuned and zero-shot settings reveal consistent weaknesses in current forensic approaches. Fine-tuned detectors perform well in-distribution but lose up to 50\% accuracy on unseen generators or disaster types, showing overfitting to model-specific artifacts. Zero-shot generalized detectors also struggle to maintain stable accuracy, with only limited resilience in a few representation-robust models. These findings highlight persistent generalization gaps and the urgent need for domain- and model-agnostic detection methods to ensure visual authenticity in the diffusion era.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Forged Calamity基准数据集（30,000张图像，包含真实与AI生成的灾难场景图片），实验表明当前检测方法在跨生成器和灾难类型时存在严重泛化缺陷，微调模型准确性下降高达50%，亟需领域无关的检测方法。
AI.motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型能生成高度逼真的合成图像，使真实与AI生成内容难以区分，对网络安全、数字取证和灾难响应（如洪水、火灾、地震的虚假图像传播）构成严重威胁。
AI.method: 构建了包含30,000张图像（6,000张真实、24,000张合成）的Forged Calamity基准数据集，使用四种扩散模型生成样本，在微调和零样本两种设置下进行综合实验评估。
AI.result: 微调检测器在分布内表现良好，但在未见过的生成器或灾难类型上准确性下降高达50%；零样本检测器也难以保持稳定准确性，仅少数表示鲁棒模型表现出有限的适应性。
AI.conclusion: 当前检测方法存在显著的泛化差距，亟需开发领域和模型无关的检测方法以应对扩散时代下的视觉真实性挑战。

title: R2D-RL: A RoboCup 2D Soccer Environment for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Robot soccer is a challenging testbed for multi-agent reinforcement learning because it combines partial observability, cooperative and adversarial interaction, sparse rewards, and long-horizon tactical behavior. RoboCup 2D Soccer Simulation (RCSS2D) provides a mature robot-soccer platform, but its competition-oriented server-client architecture is difficult to use directly with modern Python-based MARL workflows. We introduce R2D-RL, a reinforcement learning environment that connects RCSS2D and HELIOS-based player clients to a Python MARL interface through shared-memory communication and cycle-level synchronization. R2D-RL supports full-field and scenario-based training with configurable opponents, Base discrete and Hybrid parameterized action spaces, action masks, expected possession value (EPV)-based reward shaping, and parallel execution. We provide front-goal scenarios and an 11-vs-11 full-field benchmark, together with baseline results.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍R2D-RL，一个将RoboCup 2D足球仿真平台与Python MARL框架连接起来的强化学习环境，支持全场和场景训练、混合动作空间、EPV奖励塑造等特性。
AI.motivation: 机器人足球是MARL的挑战性测试平台，但RCSS2D的竞赛导向架构难以直接与现代Python MARL工作流结合，需要一个连接两者的接口环境。
AI.method: 通过共享内存通信和周期级同步，将RCSS2D和HELIOS客户端连接到Python MARL接口；支持离散和混合参数化动作空间、动作掩码、基于EPV的奖励塑造以及并行执行。
AI.result: 提供了前场进球场景和11对11全场基准测试，并给出了基线结果。
AI.conclusion: R2D-RL为RCSS2D提供了一个易用的Python MARL接口，解决了原有平台与现代深度学习框架的兼容性问题。

title: Rethinking Text-to-Image as Semantic-Aware Data Augmentation for Indoor Scene Recognition
summary: In the realm of computer vision, indoor image recognition presents challenges due to the intricate interplay of lighting conditions, occlusions, and diverse object arrangements within confined spaces. To address the lacks of training indoor images, we introduce a novel approach leveraging Stable Diffusion (SD) for the generation of synthetic images, which serve as a powerful data augmentation tool. The utilization of SD offers a principled framework for synthesizing diverse and realistic indoor scenes, thereby enriching the training data pool for robust indoor image recognition models. Experimental findings on the MIT Indoor Scene dataset reveal the potential of our proposed approach in enhancing the training of deep models when authentic data is limited. Furthermore, to prevent the misuse of SD synthetic images, we introduce a counter measure based on DIffusion Reconstruction Error (DIRE). The powerful DIRE presentation enables training robust classifiers only using lightweight deep models. Experiments show that our approach can perfectly recognize SD generated images with the accuracy of 100% using MobilenetV3.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用Stable Diffusion生成合成图像进行数据增强以解决室内图像识别中训练数据不足的问题，同时引入基于扩散重建误差（DIRE）的检测方法防止合成图像滥用，在MIT Indoor Scene数据集上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 室内图像识别面临光照条件复杂、遮挡以及物体布局多样等挑战，且真实训练数据有限，需要有效的数据增强方法来提升模型性能。
AI.method: 使用Stable Diffusion生成合成室内场景图像进行数据增强；同时提出基于DIffusion Reconstruction Error（DIRE）的方法来检测和防止SD合成图像的滥用。
AI.result: 在MIT Indoor Scene数据集上验证了方法有效性，DIRE方法使用轻量级模型MobilenetV3即可达到100%的SD生成图像识别准确率。
AI.conclusion: 利用Stable Diffusion进行数据增强可有效缓解室内图像识别中数据不足的问题，而DIRE检测方法能够完美区分真实图像与SD合成图像，防止合成图像的潜在滥用。

title: ProfiLLM: Utility-Aligned Agentic User Profiling for Industrial Ride-Hailing Dispatch
summary: Bringing Large Language Models (LLMs) into industrial ride-hailing dispatch as semantic feature extractors over platform-scale behavioral logs is a compelling but under-explored data systems problem. Production matching pipelines remain dominated by structured numerical features, yet decisive behavioral signals (e.g., a driver's habitual aversion to certain regions) are inherently contextual and naturally expressible as LLM-generated user profiles. However, scaling such profiling to a live, millisecond-latency dispatcher faces three intertwined constraints rarely addressed together: on a platform with millions of daily orders, logs exceed any LLM's context window by orders of magnitude; most users are long-tail, with too few interactions for per-user profiling; and surface-fluent profiles do not necessarily improve downstream prediction utility. We present ProfiLLM, an agentic LLM data pipeline that operationalizes utility-aligned user profiling for production matching systems through two modules. (1) Tool-Augmented Global Knowledge Mining equips an LLM agent with 27 analytical tools to mine platform-scale data, producing reusable global knowledge, adaptive user clustering rules, and region-level supply-demand priors. (2) Utility-Aligned Profile Exploration generates multiple candidate profiles per cluster, evaluates them via a lightweight downstream utility proxy, iteratively refines the best candidates and constructs preference pairs for DPO fine-tuning. Deployed on DiDi's production dispatcher, ProfiLLM achieves up to +6.14% relative AUC improvement in outcome prediction, up to +4.35% GMV gain in dispatching simulation, and consistent improvements in a 14-day online A/B test including +0.47% GMV, +0.33% Completion Rate, and -0.82% Cancel-Before-Accept rate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ProfiLLM，一个将大语言模型作为智能代理用于工业网约车调度系统的用户画像生成框架。它通过全局知识挖掘和效用对齐画像探索两个模块，在滴滴生产环境中实现了显著的预测和业务指标提升。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型在语义理解上能力出众，但工业级匹配调度系统仍主要依赖结构化数值特征。许多关键行为信号（如司机对某些区域的习惯性回避）本质上是上下文相关的语义信息，传统方法难以有效捕捉。现有研究很少同时解决三个约束：日志远超LLM上下文窗口、长尾用户交互稀疏、表面流畅的画像不一定提升下游预测效用。
AI.method: ProfiLLM包含两个核心模块：(1) 工具增强的全局知识挖掘——为LLM代理配备27种分析工具，挖掘平台级数据，生成可复用的全局知识、自适应用户聚类规则和区域级供需先验；(2) 效用对齐的画像探索——为每个聚类生成多个候选画像，通过轻量级下游效用代理进行评估，迭代优化最佳候选并构建偏好对进行DPO微调。
AI.result: 在滴滴生产调度系统中，ProfiLLM在结果预测上实现+6.14%相对AUC提升，调度模拟中+4.35% GMV增长，14天在线A/B测试中GMV提升+0.47%、完成率提升+0.33%、接单前取消率降低-0.82%。
AI.conclusion: ProfiLLM成功将LLM作为语义特征提取器集成到工业级网约车调度系统，通过解决上下文窗口、长尾用户和效用对齐三大挑战，证明了基于LLM的用户画像能够有效提升生产系统的预测能力和业务指标。

title: MolmoMotion: Forecasting Point Trajectories in 3D with Language Instruction
summary: Motion forecasting is central to visual intelligence: agents must anticipate how objects will move in order to plan actions, reason about physical interactions, and synthesize realistic futures. We argue that 3D points in world coordinates provide a general representation that is class-agnostic, view-stable, compact, and directly useful for downstream tasks. We formalize the task of goal-conditioned 3D point motion forecasting: given a short visual history, a set of 3D query points on an object of interest, and a language description of the intended goal, the model predicts the future 3D trajectory of each point. We introduce a full stack to study this task at scale: (1) MolmoMotion-1M is a large corpus of action-described, object-grounded 3D point trajectories annotated from 1.16M unconstrained videos; (2) PointMotionBench is a human-verified benchmark spanning 111 object categories and 61 motion types; and (3) MolmoMotion is a general motion forecasting model that supports both autoregressive coordinate prediction and flow-matching-based trajectory generation. MolmoMotion accurately predicts diverse motion patterns with different language instructions, and significantly outperforms existing motion prediction baselines on PointMotionBench. Finally, we show that the learned 3D motion prior transfers well to downstream applications: it improves training efficiency and generalization for robot manipulation, and its predicted trajectories provide effective motion guidance for generative models to synthesize videos with more realistic object motion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于3D世界坐标点的通用运动预测框架，包含大规模数据集MolmoMotion-1M（116万视频）、基准PointMotionBench（111类物体、61种运动）和多模态运动预测模型MolmoMotion，该模型在语言指令引导下预测物体3D点轨迹，显著优于现有方法，并可迁移至机器人操作和视频生成任务。
AI.motivation: 运动预测是视觉智能的核心，现有方法缺乏通用、类别无关且对下游任务直接有用的运动表示。作者认为3D世界坐标点是一种类无关、视角稳定、紧凑且可直接用于下游任务的通用表示，因此提出目标条件化的3D点运动预测任务。
AI.method: (1) 构建MolmoMotion-1M数据集，从116万无约束视频中标注动作描述和物体3D点轨迹；(2) 建立PointMotionBench人工验证基准；(3) 提出MolmoMotion模型，支持自回归坐标预测和基于流匹配的轨迹生成两种方式，以视觉历史、3D查询点和语言目标描述为输入。
AI.result: MolmoMotion在PointMotionBench上显著优于现有运动预测基线，能准确预测不同语言指令下的多样化运动模式。学习的3D运动先验可迁移至机器人操作（提升训练效率和泛化性）和视频生成（提供更真实的目标运动引导）。
AI.conclusion: 3D世界坐标点是运动预测的有效通用表示，大规模数据驱动的3D运动先验可有效迁移到多种下游任务中。

title: WorldLines: Benchmarking and Modeling Long-Horizon Stateful Embodied Agents
summary: To assist humans over extended periods in real homes, embodied agents must remember user routines, world states, and past interactions. Existing long-term memory benchmarks mainly evaluate language-centric retrieval and question answering, while embodied benchmarks often focus on short-horizon task execution without testing long-term memory use in dynamic environments. We introduce WorldLines, a project-driven benchmark for long-horizon embodied household assistance. It constructs temporally extended household traces with dialogues, actions, execution feedback, object and device state changes, and converts them into evidence-linked samples for Memory QA and Embodied Task Planning. We further propose ObsMem, an observer-grounded memory framework that maintains visibility-aware memories and action-native state trails for state-aware decisions. Experiments reveal persistent challenges in partial observability, overwritten world states, and translating long-term memory into embodied plans, while ObsMem offers a stronger reference architecture for this setting.

AI.tldr: WorldLines是一个面向长期家庭辅助的具身智能基准测试，包含时间跨度长的家庭任务轨迹和ObsMem记忆框架，旨在解决具身体长期记忆和动态环境下的任务规划挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有长期记忆基准主要评估语言导向的检索和问答，而具身基准则关注短期任务执行，缺乏对动态环境中长期记忆使用的测试。
AI.method: 构建了WorldLines基准，包含时间延伸的家庭轨迹（对话、动作、执行反馈、物体和设备状态变化），并转化为证据关联的记忆问答和具身任务规划样本。提出ObsMem观察者记忆框架，维护可见性感知记忆和动作原生状态轨迹。
AI.result: 实验揭示了部分可观测性、世界状态覆盖以及将长期记忆转化为具身规划等方面的持续挑战。
AI.conclusion: ObsMem为长期家庭辅助场景提供了更优的参考架构。

title: PreUnlearn: Auditing Collateral Knowledge Damage Before Large Language Model Unlearning
summary: Machine unlearning for large language models (LLMs) aims to remove specified knowledge while preserving the rest of the model's capabilities. However, the boundary between knowledge to forget and knowledge to retain is often unclear, since related and even distant information may be entangled in the model. In this paper, we study LLM unlearning from a data-centric perspective and measure how unlearning effects propagate from the forget set to same-domain and distant-domain knowledge. We find a consistent decay pattern: collateral damage is strongest near the forget set, weakens with semantic distance, but does not disappear at domain boundaries. We further ask whether such damage can be audited before unlearning is executed. We formulate forget-set auditing as a pre-unlearning prediction task and analyze which data features are most predictive of downstream damage. Our results show that interaction features between the forget set and evaluation set provide the strongest signals, suggesting that collateral damage is partly reflected in data geometry before model updates occur. These findings position forget-set auditing as an early warning tool for identifying risky unlearning runs and designing more reliable unlearning procedures.

AI.tldr: 本文从数据中心的视角研究大语言模型机器遗忘，发现遗忘效果会以语义距离衰减的模式传播到同领域和远领域知识，并提出基于遗忘集审计的预训练预测方法，利用数据交互特征提前预警可能产生的附带损害。
AI.motivation: 机器遗忘中遗忘知识与保留知识的边界模糊，相关信息甚至远距离知识在模型中相互纠缠，导致难以区分哪些知识应该被遗忘、哪些应该保留，需要系统研究遗忘效应的传播规律。
AI.method: 从数据中心的视角出发，测量遗忘效果如何从遗忘集传播到同领域和远领域知识；将遗忘集审计建模为预遗忘预测任务，分析哪些数据特征对下游损害最具预测性。
AI.result: 发现一致的衰减模式：附带损害在遗忘集附近最强，随语义距离增加而减弱，但不会在领域边界消失；遗忘集与评估集之间的交互特征对下游损害预测最强，表明数据几何结构在模型更新前已部分反映附带损害。
AI.conclusion: 遗忘集审计可作为早期预警工具，用于识别有风险的遗忘操作并设计更可靠的遗忘流程。

title: Externalizing Research Synthesis and Validation in AI Scientists through a Research Harness
summary: AI systems can increasingly automate scientific workflows, but the reasoning that links prior evidence, generated ideas, experiments and final claims often remains implicit inside model inference. Here we introduce Xcientist, a research harness that externalizes research synthesis and experimental validation into inspectable, contract-governed processes. Xcientist organizes literature evidence, idea states, implementation plans, ablation records and repair traces as persistent research artifacts, so that generated mechanisms can be grounded, executed, tested and revised without losing their evidential basis. We identify claim drift as a failure mode of automated research, where runnable artifacts no longer support the mechanism originally claimed. Across training-free memory systems, graph-structured traffic forecasting and multi-scale physics-informed neural networks, Xcientist preserves traceable trajectories from problem formulation to mechanism design, validation and bounded revision. These results suggest that AI scientists should be evaluated not only by their final artifacts, but by whether their synthesis and validation processes remain attributable, inspectable and scientifically accountable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Xcientist框架，将AI科研的推理过程外部化为可检查、可追溯的研究工件，解决了自动化科研中"声明漂移"的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有AI科研系统在自动化科学工作流时，连接先验证据、生成想法、实验验证和最终声明之间的推理过程往往是隐式的，缺乏可检查性和可归因性。
AI.method: Xcientist框架将文献证据、想法状态、实现计划、消融记录和修复轨迹作为持久化研究工件进行组织和外部化，支持可检查的、由合约约束的推理过程。
AI.result: 在无训练记忆系统、图结构交通预测和多尺度物理信息神经网络等多个任务上，Xcientist能够保持从问题定义到机制设计、验证和有限修正的可追溯轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 评估AI科学家不应仅看最终工件，还应考量其合成和验证过程是否可归因、可检查且具有科学可问责性。

title: Towards Scalable Customization and Deployment of Multi-Agent Systems for Enterprise Applications
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems demonstrate strong performance on complex reasoning and task execution, enabling broad enterprise applications. However, production deployment remains challenging due to domain-specific customization requirements and high latency and inference costs in agentic workflows. We propose a unified framework for customization and efficient deployment of multi-agent systems in real-world settings. The first stage, Agentic Model Customization, combines continual pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and preference optimization to adapt a compact model to specialized domains while retaining strong agentic capabilities. The second stage, Inference Optimization, integrates speculative decoding and FP8 quantization with targeted calibration to enable cost-efficient serving with minimal quality loss. Across enterprise workloads, our framework enables rapid domain adaptation and achieves a 4.48x speedup in throughput while maintaining performance and improving robustness on long-tail scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出一个两阶段框架，先通过持续预训练、监督微调和偏好优化对小型LLM进行领域定制，再通过推测性解码和FP8量化实现高效推理部署，在企业场景下获得4.48倍吞吐加速且保持性能。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的多智能体系统在复杂推理和任务执行上表现优异，但在生产部署中面临领域定制困难、高延迟和高推理成本等挑战。
AI.method: 第一阶段（智能体模型定制）：结合持续预训练、监督微调和偏好优化，将紧凑模型适配到特定领域；第二阶段（推理优化）：整合推测性解码和FP8量化（带目标校准），实现低成本高效推理。
AI.result: 在企业工作负载上实现快速领域适配，吞吐量提升4.48倍，同时保持性能并在长尾场景提升鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该统一框架有效解决了多智能体系统从定制到部署的全链条挑战，兼顾性能与效率。

title: Multi-Modal Hyper-Graph Fusion for Low-Light Crowd Counting
summary: Crowd counting is a fundamental task in computer vision. However, crowd counting in low-light environments remains largely underexplored, despite its practical importance in the real world. Existing methods mainly focus on well-lit scenes or rely on single-modality Red-Green-Blue (RGB) representations, which often become unreliable under extreme darkness and complex non-uniform illumination. To handle this problem, we construct three new low-light crowd counting benchmarks, which consist of two synthetic datasets, SHA\_Dark and SHB\_Dark, and a real-world benchmark LC-Crowd (Low-light Crowd Dataset). Inspired by Retinex-based physical modeling, we introduce depth and Canny edge cues as complementary geometric and structural priors to enhance the intrinsic reflectance representation under low-light conditions. We propose a Multi-Modal Hyper-Graph Fusion module, which formulates RGB appearance, depth geometry, and edge structure cues as nodes in a unified hyper-graph and explicitly captures their high-order complementary relationships via dynamic hyperedge construction and message passing. Furthermore, to adaptively allocate computation in dense prediction, we propose a Deformable Rectangular Sparse Attention (DRSA) module, which concentrates computation on informative regions through anchor-aware estimation and adaptive rectangular window modeling. Based on these designs, we develop a unified Low-Light Counting Network (LCNet) for robust low-light crowd counting. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed method achieves the best overall performance against existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods. The code is in the supplementary material. The datasets will be made public upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文针对低光照环境下的人群计数问题，构建了三个新的低光照基准数据集，并提出了一种基于Retinex物理建模的多模态超图融合方法（LCNet），利用深度和Canny边缘先验增强反射率表示，结合可变形矩形稀疏注意力模块，在多个基准上取得了最优性能。
AI.motivation: 低光照人群计数在实际应用中非常重要，但现有方法主要针对良好光照场景或仅依赖单模态RGB表示，在极端黑暗和复杂非均匀光照条件下表现不可靠，这一问题尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 1）构建了两个合成数据集（SHA_Dark, SHB_Dark）和一个真实世界基准（LC-Crowd）；2）引入深度和Canny边缘线索作为几何和结构先验；3）提出多模态超图融合模块（MMHG），将RGB、深度、边缘作为节点，通过动态超边构建和消息传递捕获高阶互补关系；4）提出可变形矩形稀疏注意力（DRSA），通过锚点感知和自适应矩形窗口建模实现计算资源的自适应分配；5）基于以上设计构建统一低光照计数网络（LCNet）。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在整体性能上优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了引入多模态几何和结构先验、结合超图融合与自适应稀疏注意力机制，能够有效解决低光照环境下的鲁棒人群计数问题。

title: Generative-Model Predictive Planning for Navigation in Partially Observable Environments
summary: Navigation in partially observable environments presents a significant challenge for autonomous agents, requiring effective decision-making with limited sensory information in unknown environments. Belief-based methods, particularly those using neural networks to approximate the belief space, often fail to capture the inherent multimodality of belief spaces, especially in high-dimensional cases with perceptual aliasing. While generative models present a compelling alternative, they typically require substantial data or expert demonstrations and lack explicit mechanisms for long-term planning. In this paper, we introduce BeliefDiffusion, a novel framework that combines the benefits of both generation and planning. BeliefDiffusion leverages diffusion models to explicitly characterize multimodal belief distributions and utilizes Model Predictive Control (MPC) to simultaneously plan ahead. It consists of two steps: (1) Imagining plausible environment configurations based on observation history and (2) Planning efficient navigation strategies across an aggregated configurations. Through extensive experiments in synthetic map environments, we demonstrate that BeliefDiffusion significantly outperforms both model-free reinforcement learning baselines and other generative approaches in navigation success rate and path efficiency. Our results validate that explicitly incorporating multimodal belief representations into planning enables more robust navigation in partially observable settings.

AI.tldr: BeliefDiffusion 是一个结合扩散模型和模型预测控制的导航框架，通过显式建模多模态信念分布并在聚合配置上进行规划，有效解决了部分可观测环境中的导航问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于信念的方法难以捕捉高维部分可观测环境中信念空间的内在多模态性，而生成模型缺乏长期规划机制，导致在感知混淆场景下导航效果不佳。
AI.method: 提出 BeliefDiffusion 框架，包含两个步骤：(1) 基于观测历史利用扩散模型生成多模态的环境配置（即"想象"）；(2) 在聚合的配置上使用模型预测控制（MPC）进行高效导航策略规划。
AI.result: 在合成地图环境中的实验表明，BeliefDiffusion 在导航成功率和路径效率上显著优于无模型强化学习基线和其他生成方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式地将多模态信念表示融入规划过程，能够显著提升部分可观测环境下导航的鲁棒性。

title: MCompassRAG: Topic Metadata as a Semantic Compass for Paragraph-Level Retrieval
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems depend critically on how documents are chunked and searched. Fine-grained chunks can improve retrieval precision but expand the search space, increasing latency and cost; larger chunks reduce the number of candidates but make dense similarity less reliable, as the representation for each chunk mixes multiple topics and introduces more semantic noise. This trade-off becomes especially limiting in deep research tasks, where retrieval must be both fast and precise across large, heterogeneous corpora. We introduce MCompassRAG, a metadata-guided retrieval framework that uses topic-level signals as a semantic compass for selecting relevant evidence. Instead of relying only on cosine similarity between queries and noisy chunk embeddings, MCompassRAG enriches chunk representations with topic metadata in the same embedding space and trains a lightweight retriever through LLM-teacher distillation. At inference time, MCompassRAG performs topic-aware retrieval without additional LLM calls, improving both efficiency and evidence quality. Across six complex retrieval benchmarks, MCompassRAG improves information efficiency (IE) by 8.24% on average with over 5 times lower latency than the strongest efficient RAG baselines. Code is available on https://github.com/AmirAbaskohi/MCompassRAG.

AI.tldr: MCompassRAG提出了一种元数据引导的检索框架，通过用主题级信号增强文档块表示并利用LLM教师蒸馏训练轻量检索器，在不增加额外LLM调用的情况下提升检索效率和证据质量，相比现有方法在信息效率上平均提升8.24%，延迟降低5倍以上。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG系统在文档分块和检索时面临权衡：细粒度块提升检索精度但增加搜索空间和延迟，粗粒度块减少候选数但导致稠密相似度不可靠，尤其在大规模异构语料库的深度研究任务中问题突出。
AI.method: MCompassRAG采用元数据引导的检索框架，使用主题级信号增强块表示，在同一嵌入空间中丰富语义信息，并通过LLM教师蒸馏训练轻量级检索器，推理时无需额外LLM调用即可实现主题感知检索。
AI.result: 在六个复杂检索基准上，MCompassRAG平均提升信息效率(IE) 8.24%，且延迟比最强高效RAG基线降低5倍以上。
AI.conclusion: MCompassRAG通过主题元数据引导有效解决了RAG系统中检索效率与精度的权衡问题，在不增加推理成本的前提下显著提升检索质量。

title: Skill-Guided Continuation Distillation for GUI Agents
summary: Improving GUI agents typically relies on behavior cloning on expert trajectories. However, as the current policy deviates from the expert policy, it inevitably encounters policy-induced off-trajectory states during closed-loop execution, i.e., states that fall outside the expert trajectories. Since expert trajectories provide no demonstrations for these unseen states, such states receive no effective supervision, leaving the policy unable to select the correct action. To close this supervision gap, we propose Skill-Guided Continuation Distillation (SGCD), an iterative self-improvement framework. SGCD first runs the plain policy without skill guidance for a few steps to reach realistic off-trajectory states. From these states, a skill-guided policy then completes the task and produces successful continuations, which are mixed with expert trajectories to supply supervision over policy-induced off-trajectory states. The skills are extracted from both successful and failed rollouts, consisting of Continuation Plans, Critical Targets, Failure Traps, and Success Criteria. On OSWorld-Verified, SGCD improves the success rate of three base models from the low-30\% range to over 50\%, demonstrating its effectiveness and generality.

AI.tldr: 提出SGCD框架，通过技能引导的持续蒸馏来填补GUI智能体在策略诱导的偏离轨迹状态上的监督空白，将三个基础模型的成功率从30%左右提升至超过50%。
AI.motivation: 现有GUI智能体依赖行为克隆专家轨迹，但执行中策略偏离会导致遇到专家轨迹未覆盖的状态（off-trajectory states），这些状态缺乏有效监督，限制了策略性能。
AI.method: SGCD迭代自改进框架：(1)首先运行无技能引导的原始策略若干步到达真实偏离轨迹状态；(2)从这些状态出发，用技能引导策略完成任务并生成成功延续轨迹；(3)将成功延续与专家轨迹混合，为偏离轨迹状态提供监督信号。技能从成功和失败的rollout中提取，包含延续计划、关键目标、失败陷阱和成功标准。
AI.result: 在OSWorld-Verified基准上，SGCD将三种基础模型的成功率从约30%提升至超过50%，验证了其有效性和通用性。
AI.conclusion: SGCD通过利用技能引导生成的成功延续轨迹来填补监督空白，是一种有效且通用的GUI智能体自改进框架。

title: SciRisk-Bench: A Risk-Dimension-Aware Benchmark for AI4Science Safety
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly embedded in AI for Science (AI4Science) workflows, from scientific question answering and literature analysis to laboratory planning and autonomous discovery. This progress creates an urgent need for safety benchmarks that evaluate not only scientific competence, but also whether models recognize and avoid risks in high-stakes scientific contexts. Existing AI4Science safety datasets cover several disciplines and task formats, leaving the underlying risk dimensions underspecified. We introduce \textbf{SciRisk-Bench}, a benchmark designed to evaluate AI4Science safety from two complementary perspectives: explicit risk dimensions and scientific disciplines. SciRisk-Bench covers 7 disciplines, 31 subdisciplines and 10 risk dimensions. In the experimental section, we evaluate both mainstream LLMs and science-oriented LLMs across risk dimensions, disciplines, and sub-disciplines, enabling fine-grained diagnosis of where scientific models remain unsafe.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SciRisk-Bench，一个从显式风险维度和科学学科两个互补角度评估AI4Science安全的基准测试，覆盖7个学科、31个子学科和10个风险维度，用于诊断科学模型在哪些方面仍然不安全。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在AI for Science工作流中日益普及，从科学问答、文献分析到实验室规划和自主发现，这迫切需要能够评估模型在高风险科学情境中识别和避免风险能力的安全基准，而现有AI4Science安全数据集覆盖了若干学科和任务格式，但未能充分定义底层风险维度。
AI.method: 从显式风险维度和科学学科两个互补角度设计基准，覆盖7个学科、31个子学科和10个风险维度，对主流LLMs和科学导向LLMs进行跨风险维度、学科和子学科的细粒度评估。
AI.result: 对主流大语言模型和科学导向大语言模型进行了实验评估，能够在风险维度、学科和子学科层面进行细粒度诊断，识别科学模型仍不安全的区域。
AI.conclusion: SciRisk-Bench为AI4Science安全评估提供了更全面的框架，能够细粒度地诊断科学模型在不同风险维度和学科中的安全性表现。

title: Dual Dimensionality for Local and Global Attention
summary: Decoder-only Transformers compute attention over the KV cache of preceding tokens. Keys (and Values) are typically represented with the same dimensionality, regardless of its distance from the prediction target. In natural language, however, the next word is most strongly influenced by the immediately preceding tokens. We hypothesize that local and distant tokens impose asymmetric demands on representational capacity: local tokens are more critical for predicting immediate outputs and thus require richer representations, whereas distant tokens primarily serve as long-range memory, for which lower-dimensional representations may suffice. We formalize this idea as Distance-Adaptive Representation (DAR), implemented in a controlled setting that preserves full-dimensional representations within a local context window while assigning reduced-dimensional representations (e.g. 1/4 of the original dimensionality) to tokens beyond that window. Across multiple pretraining scales (70M to 410M parameters), as well as continued supervised fine-tuning on a 1B-scale model, this approach closely matches the performance of full-dimensional baselines. In contrast, uniformly reducing dimensionality across all token positions leads to worse performance. These results challenge the common assumption that key and value dimensionality should be uniform across token positions. Our findings suggest a new direction for designing attention architectures that adaptively allocate representational capacity across sequences, enabling further reductions in KV cache during inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出距离自适应表示（DAR）方法，对局部上下文窗口内的令牌保持全维表示，而对远端令牌使用低维表示（如1/4维度），在多个预训练规模（70M-410M参数）和1B模型微调中均接近全维基线性能，且优于均匀降维方法。
AI.motivation: 现有Decoder-only Transformers对所有距离的令牌键值使用相同维度，但自然语言中局部令牌对预测更重要，远端令牌主要作为长期记忆，因此假设不同距离的令牌对表示能力有非对称需求。
AI.method: 提出距离自适应表示（DAR）：在局部上下文窗口内保留全维表示，对窗口外的远端令牌分配降维表示（如原始维度的1/4）。
AI.result: 在70M到410M参数的多种预训练规模以及1B模型的监督微调中，DAR方法性能接近全维基线，且优于均匀降低所有位置维度的方案。
AI.conclusion: 挑战了键值维度应跨令牌位置均匀分布的传统假设，提出了一种自适应分配序列表示能力的新方向，可进一步减少推理时的KV缓存。

title: APT: Atomic Physical Transitions for Causal Video-Language Understanding
summary: Physical events are not understood by their names alone, but by the causal state changes that compose them. A clip-level label such as "bounce" can be correct while hiding the process that makes the event physically valid, from support loss and contact onset to rebound and settling. To make this hidden process explicit, we introduce Atomic Physical Transitions (APTs): minimal, temporally localized state changes that bind a visible cue to an active physical mechanism and before/after dynamical regimes. An APT chain represents a video as an ordered causal transition sequence rather than a single aggregate event label: event labels tell what happened; APT chains explain why it happened. To make APTs learnable by VLMs, we construct mixed-source APT data from human annotations and simulator ground truth, covering 14 transition types across contact, gravity, friction, and rotation/stability, with 27,303 timed instances over 1,246 trials. Using this data, we find that current VLMs miss transition-level physics, with zero-shot recall at most 14% and errors dominated by missed transitions. Direct fine-tuning on APT chains improves transition detection but causes event-level forgetting, indicating that the model learns a specialized answer format rather than a reusable physical representation. We therefore propose APT-Tune, a parameter-efficient recipe that teaches VLMs to use causal transitions without forgetting how to answer video questions. It combines image-pad-aware supervision, format-conditional co-training, and mechanism-conditioned domain-to-type decoding to make APT learning format-robust and physically grounded. With only 11 M LoRA parameters on Qwen3-VL-2B, APT-Tune substantially improves APT recall while also improving event-level video transfer. These results show that APTs are not a new answer format, but a human-aligned causal supervision signal for physical video understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出原子物理状态迁移（APT）概念，将视频理解从事件标签（“发生了什么”）提升为因果状态变化链（“为什么发生”），并设计APT-Tune方法使VLM在不遗忘事件级能力的前提下学习这种因果表示。
AI.motivation: 现有视频理解模型仅依赖事件名称（如“弹跳”）进行理解，忽略了隐藏的物理因果过程（如支撑丢失、接触开始、反弹、稳定）。作者希望让VLM能够显式理解事件的因果状态变化链，而不仅仅是事件标签。
AI.method: 1) 定义14种原子物理状态迁移（APT）类型；2) 构建包含27,303个时序标注实例的混合来源数据集（人工标注+仿真器真值）；3) 提出APT-Tune微调方案，包含图像填充感知监督、格式条件联合训练、机制条件域到类型解码三部分。
AI.result: 基线VLM零样本APT召回率仅14%；直接微调虽提升检测但导致事件级遗忘；APT-Tune仅用11M LoRA参数在Qwen3-VL-2B上显著提升APT召回率，同时改善事件级视频迁移性能。
AI.conclusion: APT不是一种新的答案格式，而是一种符合人类认知的因果监督信号，能够帮助VLM真正理解物理视频中的因果机制。

title: Bridging Creative Intent and Visual Quality: Creator-Driven Recurrent Video Generation with Agentic Feedback Loops
comment: Accepted to the Workshop on Human-AI Co-Creativity at ICML 2026
summary: Generative AI has made content creation increasingly accessible, but many AI-generated videos lack narrative coherence and creative direction, issues that become more substantial at longer durations. Unlike coding, where AI generation benefits from reliable feedback and techniques such as recurrent self-improvement, video generation requires subjective feedback about plot, scenes, and narrative, which naturally motivates approaches that incorporate human creative direction. We introduce CHIEF, a human-AI co-creation video generation framework that places the creator at the center of human-in-the-loop iterative video refinement, and supports them by providing automatic subjective feedback. The creator incorporates their creative direction by driving each iteration, while their revisions are incorporated by a specialized refiner agent. The feedback loop is generated by persona-conditioned multimodal LLMs that watch generated videos and produce subjective critique from the audience perspectives, providing feedback that self-evaluation alone cannot capture. To test the effectiveness of our proposed framework, we work with high school and college students with no prior filmmaking experience to create videos, from short 1-minute videos to a complete short 10-minute film with a complicated plot.

AI.tldr: 提出CHIEF框架，一种人机协作的视频生成系统，通过人机循环迭代和AI主观反馈（多模态LLM模拟观众视角）来提升AI生成视频的叙事连贯性和创意方向，实验证明无电影制作经验的学生也能用其制作从1分钟到10分钟的完整短片。
AI.motivation: AI生成视频缺乏叙事连贯性和创意方向，且时长越长问题越严重；与编程不同，视频生成需要主观反馈，自然需要引入人类创意指导。
AI.method: 提出CHIEF框架，核心包括：（1）人机循环迭代，创作者驱动每次迭代；（2）专门的精炼智能体（refiner agent）整合修改；（3）基于角色条件化的多模态LLM从观众视角生成主观批评反馈，弥补自我评估的不足。
AI.result: 与无电影制作经验的高中生和大学生合作，成功制作从1分钟短视频到10分钟完整短片的作品。
AI.conclusion: 将人类创意置于中心、结合AI主观反馈的迭代式人机协作框架，能有效提升AI视频生成的叙事质量，使无经验用户也能创作较复杂的视频内容。

title: RTSGameBench: An RTS Benchmark for Strategic Reasoning by Vision-Language Models
summary: Modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs) often struggle with strategic reasoning, i.e., anticipating and influencing other agents' actions, under uncertainty in competitive and cooperative settings. Real-time strategy (RTS) games can be a natural testbed for diagnosing this limitation, as they demand coordination with allies, adaptation to opponents' strategy, and long-horizon planning under partial observability. However, existing RTS benchmarks offer limited evaluation scope, lack systematic competency diagnosis, and remain fixed in the pre-designed scenario coverage. To address these limitations, we present RTSGameBench, which is built on Beyond All Reason, a large-scale RTS game with an expanded battlefield that demands broader strategy diversity than the existing testbeds. The proposed benchmark provides evaluations through diverse gameplay across various matchup structures, diagnostic assessment via mini-games, each targeting an individual strategic competency, and extensible coverage via a self-evolving generation framework that converts free-form queries into new mini-games, improving over successive cycles. Additionally, for VLMs to operate in large-scale RTS games, we provide RTSGameAgent that manages units by an FSM with agentic memory. We empirically validate that multiple state-of-the-art VLMs do not perform well when matchups demand tighter coordination, multiagent coordination and when task scale increases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RTSGameBench——基于大规模RTS游戏《Beyond All Reason》的基准测试，用于诊断VLMs在战略推理、多智能体协调和长期规划方面的能力缺陷，并配套提供RTSGameAgent框架辅助VLMs在游戏环境中运行。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM在竞争/合作场景中战略推理能力不足，而现有的RTS基准测试评估范围有限、缺乏系统化能力诊断、且场景覆盖固定不可扩展。
AI.method: 构建RTSGameBench，包含多样化对战结构的评估、针对单项战略能力的小游戏诊断、以及自进化生成框架（将自由形式查询转化为新小游戏）；同时提供RTSGameAgent（基于有限状态机和智能体记忆管理单元）。
AI.result: 多个最先进VLM在需要紧密协调、多智能体协作以及任务规模扩大时表现不佳。
AI.conclusion: 当前VLMs在复杂战略推理和多智能体协调任务中存在显著能力短板，RTSGameBench可作为有效的诊断工具推动该领域发展。

title: Steerable Cultural Preference Optimization of Reward Models
summary: It is essential for large language model (LLM) technology to serve many different cultural sub-communities in a manner that is acceptable to each community. However, research on LLM alignment has so far predominantly focused on predicting a unified response preference of annotators from certain regions. This paper aims to advance the development of alignment models with a more global outlook, that are able to accurately represent the preferences of subcommunities and do not exhibit excessive bias towards any of them. We focus on the development of reward models for this purpose and present a novel reward model training algorithm (SCPO) that can incorporate diverse cultural preferences in a balanced manner. Our method results in performance increases of the minority reward model of up to 7 points over the baseline model across two datasets, PRISM and GlobalOpinionQA, and across 7 countries. SCPO is up to 280% more training data-efficient than full-data finetuning of reward models. In addition, we perform analysis of bias by separately evaluating on the preference of subcommunities and show that excessive bias is mitigated via our weighting method. Our code is available at https://github.com/minsik-ai/Steerable-Cultural-Preference

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCPO算法，通过加权方式平衡不同文化子社区的偏好，使奖励模型更公平地代表全球多样化的价值观，在PRISM和GlobalOpinionQA数据集上显著提升少数群体奖励模型性能，并减少偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM对齐研究主要关注预测统一响应偏好，忽略了不同文化子社区之间的偏好差异，导致模型可能对某些群体存在过度偏差。需要开发能够平衡代表全球多元文化偏好的对齐模型。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的奖励模型训练算法SCPO（Steerable Cultural Preference Optimization），通过加权方法将多样化的文化偏好以平衡方式融入奖励模型训练中。
AI.result: 在PRISM和GlobalOpinionQA两个数据集上，跨7个国家，少数群体奖励模型性能提升高达7个百分点；训练数据效率比全数据微调奖励模型高出280%；通过分社区评估验证了加权方法有效缓解了过度偏差。
AI.conclusion: SCPO能够更公平地代表不同文化子社区的偏好，在提升少数群体表现的同时减少偏差，为构建更具全球视野的LLM对齐模型提供了有效方案。

title: Intrinsic 4D Gaussian Segmentation from Scene Cues
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. Includes supplementary material. Preprint
summary: Dynamic 4D Gaussian Splatting reconstructs deforming scenes with high fidelity and is increasingly adopted as a representation for dynamic 3D scenes. Putting such a scene to use, for editing, manipulation or motion analysis, first requires segmenting it: grouping the Gaussian primitives into coherent objects. Current pipelines obtain this grouping by importing 2D masks from foundation models such as SAM and lifting or distilling them into the Gaussian representation. In dynamic scenes these masks must be generated across many frames and views, which is costly, and the resulting segmentation can depend strongly on the quality and consistency of those external masks.
