Extensive experiments across natural and portrait benchmarks demonstrate that this optimal synergy enables Moebius to rival or even surpass the generation quality of the 10B-level industrial generalist FLUX.1-Fill-Dev. Remarkably, Moebius achieves this using less than 2\% of the parameters (0.22B vs. 11.9B) while delivering a $>15\times$ acceleration in total inference time, setting a new efficiency standard for high-fidelity inpainting. Project page at https://hustvl.github.io/Moebius.

AI.tldr: Moebius是一个极轻量级图像修复框架，仅用0.22B参数（FLUX.1-Fill-Dev的不到2%）实现超越10B级工业模型的生成质量，同时实现>15倍推理加速。
AI.motivation: 10B级工业基础模型在图像修复任务上效果优异，但计算成本过高，难以实际部署；极端结构化压缩又会导致严重的表示瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出Local-λ Mix Interaction (LλMI)模块，由Local-λ和Interactive-λ组成，将空间上下文和全局语义先验压缩为固定尺寸线性矩阵；并配合自适应多粒度蒸馏策略，在隐空间内动态平衡多种梯度损失以实现高保真对齐。
AI.result: 在自然图像和人像基准测试中，Moebius（0.22B参数）达到或超越FLUX.1-Fill-Dev（11.9B参数）的生成质量，总推理时间加速超过15倍。
AI.conclusion: 最优的轻量级架构与蒸馏策略协同，能够在极小参数量下实现高保真图像修复，树立了新的效率标杆。

title: ROSA-TFormer: A Radar-Optical Sensor-Aware Temporal Transformer for Pinus sylvestris Plantation Classification in Northern Shaanxi Using GEE-Derived Sentinel-1/2 Time Series
summary: Accurate identification of Pinus sylvestris var. mongolica plantations is important for monitoring afforestation quality and ecological restoration in northern Shaanxi. This paper proposes ROSA-TFormer, a radar-optical sensor-aware temporal Transformer for P. sylvestris classification using Sentinel-1/2 time-series data generated on Google Earth Engine. The model integrates separate SAR and optical embedding branches, a sensor-aware gate, and temporal attention pooling to capture multi-source seasonal features. Experiments on monthly and half-month point-level datasets show that ROSA-TFormer achieves strong classification performance, with 99.67% overall accuracy, 99.56% macro F1, and 98.91% P. sylvestris F1 on the HalfMonth-dataBig dataset. Spatial block validation and ablation results further indicate the effectiveness of radar-optical temporal fusion and sensor-aware modeling. The results demonstrate the potential of ROSA-TFormer for point-level P. sylvestris plantation classification, while broader wall-to-wall validation remains necessary.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ROSATFormer模型，利用雷达和光学卫星时序数据识别樟子松人工林，在半月数据集上达到99.67%的总体准确率。
AI.motivation: 准确识别樟子松人工林对陕北地区造林质量监测和生态恢复评估至关重要。
AI.method: 基于Google Earth Engine生成Sentinel-1/2时序数据，构建ROSATFormer模型，包含SAR和光学独立嵌入分支、传感器感知门控机制以及时序注意力池化模块，实现多源季节特征融合。
AI.result: 在半月点级数据集上，总体准确率99.67%，宏F1分数99.56%，樟子松F1分数98.91%。空间块验证和消融实验证明了雷达-光学时序融合和传感器感知建模的有效性。
AI.conclusion: ROSATFormer在点级樟子松人工林分类中表现优异，但更大范围的wall-to-wall验证仍有必要。

title: Transformer Geometry Observatory TGO-I: Spectral Geometry Observatory
summary: Despite the widespread adoption of Vision Transformers (ViTs) and their success across numerous computer vision applications, the fundamental understanding of their dimensional and representational geometry remains relatively underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce Transformer Geometry Observatory (TGO), a systematic framework of experiments and analysis pipelines designed to investigate the representational geometry and dynamics of Vision Transformers. TGO-I, the first installment of the framework, focuses on the spectral geometry of ViT representations. Using a ViT-Small/16 model trained on ImageNet-100, we analyze Effective Rank, Stable Rank, Participation Ratio, Spectral Entropy, Spectral Flatness, Spectral Anisotropy, covariance structure, eigenspectra, and singular value spectra throughout training. Our results reveal a consistent increase in dimensional utilization, accompanied by decreasing anisotropy, increasing spectral entropy, increasing participation ratio, and progressively flatter eigenspectra. Contrary to the common intuition that training should concentrate information into a small number of dominant directions, we observe a progressive redistribution of variance across representational dimensions. This phenomenon is particularly pronounced in the final CLS token representation, which exhibits the highest effective dimensionality and lowest anisotropy within the network.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Transformer几何观测站（TGO）框架，系统研究视觉Transformer（ViT）的表示几何和动态特性。通过对ViT-Small/16模型在ImageNet-100上的训练过程进行分析，发现训练过程中维度利用率持续增加，各向异性降低，光谱熵增加，特征值谱趋于平坦，表明表征维度发生渐进式重新分布，而非向少数主导方向集中。
AI.motivation: 尽管ViT在众多计算机视觉应用中取得了成功，但其维度与表示几何的基础理解仍相对缺乏探索，因此需要系统性框架来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 提出了TGO框架，其中TGO-I专注于ViT表示的谱几何分析。使用ViT-Small/16模型在ImageNet-100上训练，分析有效秩、稳定秩、参与比、谱熵、谱平坦度、谱各向异性、协方差结构、特征值谱和奇异值谱等指标。
AI.result: 训练过程中维度利用率持续增加，各向异性降低，谱熵增加，参与比增加，特征值谱趋于平坦。与直觉相反，训练并未将信息集中到少数主导方向，而是出现了方差在表征维度上的渐进式重新分布。这一现象在最终的CLS token表示中尤为明显，其有效维度最高、各向异性最低。
AI.conclusion: ViT训练过程中表征几何呈现出维度利用的扩散化趋势，而非信息压缩到低维子空间，这揭示了ViT内部表示结构的独特规律，为理解其工作机制提供了新的视角。

title: CABLE: Cloud-Assisted Bandwidth-efficient LMM-based Encoding for V2X Systems
summary: Cloud-hosted large multimodal models (LMMs) can provide strong open-vocabulary perception for Vehicle-to-Everything systems, but naively transmitting full-resolution frames from edge to cloud causes severe communication overhead and high cloud-side prefill latency. We present CABLE, a cloud-assisted bandwidth-efficient LMM-based encoding framework for edge-cloud perception. CABLE propagates the previous cloud segmentation mask on the edge using ego-motion compensation, refines it with residual-motion cues, and consolidates disconnected regions via a corridor envelope to form a robust region of interest (ROI). Only ROI-masked images are uploaded, while the cloud segmentation output is fed back as the prior for the next frame, forming a mask-to-ROI-to-LMM feedback loop. Experiments on five datasets (nuScenes, WOD-ZB, Waymo, KITTI, and CADC) show consistent communication savings while largely preserving perception, achieving $73$--$87\%$ ROI pixel-coverage reduction with $5$--$8\times$ estimated LMM prefill speedup at a modest detection-quality trade-off relative to full-frame inference.

AI.tldr: CABLE提出了一种面向车联网边缘-云端协同感知的带宽高效编码框架，通过利用历史分割掩码与运动补偿生成感兴趣区域（ROI），仅上传ROI掩码后的图像，显著降低通信开销和云端大模型推理延迟，在五个数据集上实现73%-87%的像素覆盖压缩和5-8倍预填充加速。
AI.motivation: 云侧大型多模态模型（LMM）可为车联网（V2X）提供强大的开放词汇感知能力，但直接传输全分辨率帧从边缘到云端会导致严重的通信开销和云端预填充延迟，迫切需要一种带宽高效的方法。
AI.method: CABLE框架在边缘端利用自车运动补偿传播上一帧的云侧分割掩码，通过残差运动线索精化，并利用走廊包络整合断开区域，形成稳健的ROI；仅上传ROI掩码后的图像，云侧分割输出作为下一帧的先验反馈，构成掩码-ROI-LMM闭环。
AI.result: 在nuScenes、WOD-ZB、Waymo、KITTI和CADC五个数据集上实现73%-87%的ROI像素覆盖率降低，估计LMM预填充速度提升5-8倍，检测质量仅有适度折损。
AI.conclusion: CABLE通过高效的掩码传播与ROI压缩策略，在保持感知性能的同时大幅节省边缘-云端通信带宽和云端计算延迟，为车联网场景下的LMM部署提供了一种实用的带宽高效编码框架。

title: A Unified Framework for Efficient Remote Sensing Visual Question Answering: Adapting Dual, Hybrid, and Encoder-Decoder Architectures
comment: 4 pages, 2 figures, accepted and to be presented at 2026 IEEE International Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium (IGARSS 2026), scheduled for 9 to 14 August 2026 in Washington D.C
summary: Visual Question Answering (VQA) in the Remote Sensing (RS) domain presents unique challenges due to the high resolution, multi scale object distribution, and semantic complexity of aerial imagery. While general domain Foundation Models have achieved remarkable success, their direct application to RSVQA is hindered by massive domain shifts and the computationally prohibitive nature of full fine tuning. This study presents a comparative analysis of RS Adapter, a Parameter Efficient Fine Tuning (PEFT) strategy, applied across three distinct Vision Language Model (VLM) architectures: the Dual Encoder CLIP, the Encoder Decoder BLIP, and the Hybrid FLAVA. We introduce a unified architectural surgery pipeline that injects lightweight bottleneck adapters into the attention and MLP layers of frozen backbones, enabling rapid adaptation with less than 5 percent of trainable parameters. Experimental results on the high resolution RSVQA x dataset demonstrate that while all adapted models achieve convergence, the Hybrid FLAVA architecture offers a superior balance of multimodal reasoning and retrieval capabilities compared to its unimodal counterparts. Our findings establish a new baseline for resource efficient VQA in disaster assessment and urban monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出RS Adapter，一种参数高效微调策略，将轻量级适配器注入冻结的视觉语言模型骨干网络，以不到5%的可训练参数实现遥感领域VQA任务。实验表明，混合FLAVA架构在多模态推理与检索方面优于双编码器CLIP和编码器-解码器BLIP，为资源高效的遥感VQA建立了新基准。
AI.motivation: 遥感VQA面临高分辨率、多尺度目标分布和语义复杂性等独特挑战，通用基础模型直接应用受限于领域偏移和全微调的高计算成本，需要一种参数高效的适应方法。
AI.method: 提出RS Adapter，一种PEFT策略，通过统一架构手术将轻量级瓶颈适配器注入三种VLM（CLIP、BLIP、FLAVA）的注意力层和MLP层，冻结骨干网络，仅微调不到5%的参数。
AI.result: 在RSVQA-x数据集上，所有适配模型均实现收敛；混合FLAVA架构在多模态推理与检索能力上取得最佳平衡。
AI.conclusion: RS Adapter有效解决了遥感VQA中的领域迁移和计算成本问题，为灾害评估和城市监测等场景的资源高效VQA应用建立了新基线。

title: NeuMesh++: Towards Versatile and Efficient Volumetric Editing with Disentangled Neural Mesh-based Implicit Field
summary: Recently neural implicit rendering techniques have evolved rapidly and demonstrated significant advantages in novel view synthesis and 3D scene reconstruction. However, existing neural rendering methods for editing purposes offer limited functionalities, e.g., rigid transformation and category-specific editing. In this paper, we present a novel mesh-based representation by encoding the neural radiance field with disentangled geometry, texture, and semantic codes on mesh vertices, which empowers a set of efficient and comprehensive editing functionalities, including mesh-guided geometry editing, designated texture editing with texture swapping, filling and painting operations, and semantic-guided editing. To this end, we develop several techniques including a novel local space parameterization to enhance rendering quality and training stability, a learnable modification color on vertex to improve the fidelity of texture editing, a spatial-aware optimization strategy to realize precise texture editing, and a semantic-aided region selection to ease the laborious annotation of implicit field editing. Extensive experiments and editing examples on both real and synthetic datasets demonstrate the superiority of our method on representation quality and editing ability. Project page: https://zju3dv.github.io/neumeshplusplus/

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于网格的神经隐式渲染表示方法，通过解耦几何、纹理和语义编码，实现了几何编辑、纹理编辑（交换、填充、绘制）和语义引导编辑等多种功能。
AI.motivation: 现有神经渲染编辑方法功能有限（仅支持刚体变换或类别特定编辑），缺乏高效、全面的编辑能力。
AI.method: 1) 在网格顶点上编码解耦的几何、纹理和语义码；2) 提出局部空间参数化提升渲染质量与训练稳定性；3) 可学习顶点修改颜色提高纹理编辑保真度；4) 空间感知优化策略实现精确纹理编辑；5) 语义辅助区域选择简化隐式场编辑标注。
AI.result: 在真实和合成数据集上，该方法在表示质量和编辑能力上均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 基于网格的解耦神经辐射场表示能够灵活支持多种编辑操作，且编辑效果和渲染质量优秀。

title: Beyond the Current Observation: Evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models in Controllable Non-Markov Games
summary: Deploying multimodal foundation models as closed-loop policies increasingly requires conditioning actions on observations that are no longer visible. However, existing benchmarks either expose the full state, conflate hidden-state reconstruction with other agent skills, or test recall only after an episode has ended. We introduce RNG-Bench (Reconstructive Non-Markov Games), a benchmark suite designed to isolate a base model's ability to reconstruct past observations and act on them during multi-step interaction. RNG-Bench includes two complementary games: Matching Pairs, where card identities briefly revealed at specific locations must later be recalled, and 3D Maze, where egocentric views must be integrated into a spatial map. Both games are evaluated under a unified harness with three controlled difficulty axes: grid size, visual pattern, and observation modality. The benchmark further introduces a head-to-head duel protocol to control for instance-level variance and a Memory Gap metric that disentangles forgetting from poor action selection. The hardest configurations require contexts of roughly 128K tokens and 350 image inputs per episode, and remain far from saturated by frontier MLLMs. Memory Gap analysis shows that most residual errors stem from forgetting earlier observations rather than from suboptimal decision making. Finally, fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B on optimal-policy rollouts and filtered model demonstrations improves performance on RNG-Bench and transfers to existing benchmarks without degrading general multimodal capability.

AI.tldr: RNG-Bench是一个专门测试多模态基础模型在部分可观测环境中记忆和重构过去观测能力的新基准，包含Matching Pairs和3D Maze两个游戏，通过记忆差距指标发现模型错误主要源于遗忘而非决策失误。
AI.motivation: 现有基准要么暴露完整状态、将隐藏状态重建与其他技能混淆，要么仅在回合结束后测试回忆能力。需要一个专门隔离基础模型在部分可观测环境中重建过去观测并据此行动的能力的基准。
AI.method: 设计了两个互补游戏（Matching Pairs和3D Maze），包含三个难度轴（网格大小、视觉模式、观测模态），引入头对头对决协议控制实例级方差，提出Memory Gap指标区分遗忘与决策错误，并在Qwen3.5-9B上进行微调。
AI.result: 最难配置需要约128K令牌和每回合350张图像输入，前沿MLLMs远未饱和；Memory Gap分析表明残差错误主要来自遗忘早期观测；微调Qwen3.5-9B提升了RNG-Bench性能并迁移到现有基准，不损害通用多模态能力。
AI.conclusion: RNG-Bench有效揭示了当前多模态基础模型在需要记忆和重构部分可观测环境的闭环策略中的根本局限，为未来研究提供了有价值的评估工具和训练策略。
